units.name: Annihilators with Meteoric Grandhammers

abilities.name: Force of a Falling Star
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase and the unmodified charge roll was 8+, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: The target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: As Annihilators build up momentum, their charge carries the same force as the impact of their arrival.

abilities.name: Blazing Impact
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit was set up this turn using the ‘Scions of the Storm’ ability, pick up to 3 enemy units within 10" of it to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Annihilators arrive upon the field with devastating force, twin tailed trails streaking behind them as an earth-shattering shock-wave blasts apart the foes of Sigmar.

units.lore: Only the Annihilators have the physique necessary to wield the meteoric grandhammer, a huge maul inset with a meteor fragment torn from the very firmament by the Six Smiths. Though the warriors’ advance is slow, it only takes them one well-placed blow to crush an adversary utterly.

units.name: Knight-Relictor

abilities.name: Relic Censer
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, subtract 1 from ward rolls made by the target for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The censers of the Relictor temple emanate purifying incense that can burn through the very fabric of heretical falsehoods and mystical hexes.

units.lore: As they chant dolorous lays of retribution, a Knight-Relictor will burn the bones of saints and martyrs in their skull-faced censer. The incense released from this sacrifice is imbued with warding magic that swallows heretical powers and protects their fellow Stormcasts from the imprecations of dark deities.

units.name: Yndrasta, the Celestial Spear

abilities.name: Dazzling Radiance
abilities.description: Effect: Ignore negative modifiers to the control scores of friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Yndrasta’s god-touched brilliance casts a protective aura of light around nearby Stormcasts.

abilities.name: The Prime Huntress
abilities.description: Effect: Double the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Thengavar** for attacks that target **MONSTERS**.
abilities.lore: Celestial strength, lifetimes of experience and the power of the spear Thengavar see even the most behemothic of terrors swiftly fall before Yndrasta’s fury.

abilities.name: On Wings of Brilliance
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.
abilities.lore: Yndrasta soars across the battlefield to strike at the heart of Sigmar’s enemies.

units.lore: With the resplendent white pinions granted unto her, no beast is beyond Yndrasta’s reach. Her spear, Thengavar, relentlessly seeks out its prey when thrown. There are those in the courts of Azyr who observe the cold satisfaction Yndrasta takes in slaughter and whisper that lifetimes of battle have hollowed out her soul.

units.name: Knight-Judicator with Gryph-hounds

abilities.name: Faithful Gryph-hounds
abilities.description: Effect: This unit’s **Gryph-hounds** are tokens. After setting up this unit on the battlefield for the first time, place both **Gryph-hounds** next to it.
abilities.lore: A Knight-Judicator is often accompanied into battle by a pair of these loyal beasts of Azyr.

abilities.name: Hunting Hounds
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit was not set up this turn and any of this unit’s **Gryph‑hounds** are on the battlefield, pick an enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 1, remove 1 of this unit’s **Gryph-hounds** from the battlefield. On a 2+, pick 1 of this unit’s **Gryph-hounds** that is next to this unit or next to an enemy unit and place it next to the target instead.

While any of this unit’s **Gryph-hounds** are next to an enemy unit, add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks that target that unit.

If an enemy unit is destroyed or removed from the battlefield while any of this unit’s **Gryph-hounds** are next to it, place those **Gryph-hounds** next to this unit.
abilities.lore: The Knight-Judicator sends one of their Gryph-hounds to harass an enemy unit.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Stormcast Exemplar*.

units.lore: Officers of the Justicar conclaves, the Knight-Judicators are more akin to living artillery pieces than marksmen. One of these Stormcasts typically looses the opening shot of battle, pulling back the string of their colossal terminus greatbow before releasing an arrow that unerringly finds its mark.

units.name: Lord-Relictor

abilities.name: Mortis Priest
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to chanting rolls for this unit.
abilities.lore: Though all mortals chosen by the God-King demonstrate their martial strength, those selected to become Lord-Relictors possess a rare wisdom that sets them apart.

units.lore: The high priests of the God-King’s legions, Lord‑Relictors call upon the fulminating energies of Azyr to annihilate the foe or energise their flagging brethren. As battle rages, these grim champions ward the souls of their kin and use their strange powers to guide them safely back to the Realm of Heavens.

units.name: Stormstrike Palladors

abilities.name: Ride for Vengeance
abilities.description:
Effect: If any friendly **WARRIOR CHAMBER** units have been destroyed this battle:

• You can re-roll charge rolls for this unit.
• This unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** if it charged in the same turn.
abilities.lore: As Stormcast casualties increase and the battle seems poised upon a knife’s edge, an armoured wedge of Stormstrike Palladors crashes into the enemy lines. Driven by a desire to avenge their fallen brethren, these warriors and their avian mounts unleash the fury of the storm on the God-King’s foes.

units.lore: The hard-hitting cavalry of the Warrior chambers, Stormstrike Palladors are outfitted not solely to administer a devastating charge but also to engage in extended periods of melee fighting in which their heavy blades and the talons of their Gryph-chargers prove most effective killing tools.

units.name: Neave's Companions

abilities.name: Shield of Azyr
abilities.description: Effect: While any friendly **THE BLACKTALONS HEROES** are wholly within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have **WARD (5+)**.
abilities.lore: These golden armoured warriors will willingly put themselves in mortal danger in order to protect Neave and Lorai.

details.notes: This unit can only be taken in **Neave Blacktalon**’s regiment. This unit cannot be reinforced.

units.lore: The first iteration of the Blacktalons was formed decades ago by Sigmar for the purpose of slaying an ancient god, though it eventually disbanded and passed into secrecy. Now it has been resurrected with Neave at its helm, with the intention that they will one day slay beings of a more ruinous kind.

units.name: Lord-Celestant on Dracoth

abilities.name: Extremis Chamber
abilities.description: Effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Most scarce of Sigmar’s forces are the Extremis chambers, with each Stormcast mounted on a living weapon. To draw near these warriors is to risk being scoured by lightning or flame.

abilities.name: Righteous Avengers
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO EXTREMIS CHAMBER CAVALRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Lord-Celestants inspire their brethren to mete out Sigmar’s justice; nearby Stormcasts strike the instant they are given the order.

units.lore: Some Lord-Celestants will undergo the Trials of Starwalking, a series of perilous tests that, if passed, earn them the right to ride a Dracoth mount as well as the creature’s respect. These storied commanders lead from the front atop their draconic steeds, and they are utterly devastating in combat.

units.name: Celestant-Prime, Hammer of Sigmar

abilities.name: Cometstrike Sceptre
abilities.description: Effect: Each time this unit attacks with its **Cometstrike Sceptre**, if the attack scores a hit, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: Blazing with celestial might, the Celestant-Prime raises his sceptre high before letting it fall, causing comets to rain from above.

abilities.name: Retribution From On High
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit if it is **in the Celestial Realm**.

Effect: Subtract the current battle round number from 10 to determine this unit’s strike zone. Set up this unit on the battlefield more than a number of inches equal to its strike zone from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: The Celestant-Prime descends from Azyr into the thickest fighting, Ghal Maraz glowing with power as it smites the foe.

units.lore: The Celestant-Prime serves as Sigmar’s hand. Armed with Ghal Maraz and the Cometstrike Sceptre, a celestial relic capable of snatching meteors from the firmament and hurling them to the battlefield, few can stand before him. When unleashed, the Celestant-Prime is a force of vengeance and redemption alike, guided on his holy mission by a swirling cosmic orrery that offers glimpses of future paths.

units.name: Vigilors

abilities.name: Navigators of the Storm
abilities.description: Effect: If an enemy unit had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** units that target that unit for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: As the Vigilors move swiftly beneath dark thunderclouds, the Grungni-forged arrowheads of their stormcaller bows give off flickers of lightning that reveal the location of their targets.

units.lore: Clad in thunderstrike armour, Vigilors are skilled archers who fearlessly scout out a path for their brethren. Their arrows conjure brief flashes of lightning upon impact, sending coded signals to their kin and giving away the enemy’s position

units.name: Lord-Commander Bastian Carthalos

abilities.name: Castellan of Azyr
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS INFANTRY** units to be the targets.

Effect: Each target can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
abilities.lore: Centuries spent commanding Sigmar’s prime Stormhost have sharpened Bastian’s tactical nous to a deadly edge. There are few warlords more adept than he in all the armies of Order.

abilities.name: Voice of Thunder
abilities.description: Effect: Each time a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘All-out Attack’ command, no command points are spent.
abilities.lore: Lord‑Commanders are among the few faithful who can commune with Sigmar in the heat of battle. Their words are like booming thunderclaps, each order ringing across the battlefield.

abilities.name: Mantle of the First Storm
abilities.description: Effect: If any enemy models were slain by this unit’s attacks this turn, **Heal (4)** this unit.
abilities.lore: Bastian’s armour is among the first of its kind, laboured over by Grungni himself and charged with the same holy energies as the Anvil of Apotheosis. It is a symbol of, and potent boon to, the Thunderborn’s already legendary willpower.

units.lore: Bastian Carthalos is Lord-Commander of the Hammers of Sigmar. As a mortal, he led his warriors in a daring assault against the Everchosen himself, buying time for the God-King to lead the retreat to Azyr. Sigmar looked upon Bastian’s valour with favour, calling on the ninth Great Bolt, Skjordamar, to Reforge his shattered form.

units.name: Tornus the Redeemed

abilities.name: Ruination Chamber
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-CORE ability
abilities.description: Effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.
abilities.lore: These veterans march where others cannot tread, fighting upon battlefields transformed into scenes of apocalypse. Even the most corrosive magics find no purchase on their souls.

abilities.name: The Light of Sigmar
abilities.description:
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects:

• For the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.
• **Heal (D3)** each friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** unit within this unit’s combat range.
abilities.lore: With its shutters closed, the lantern of a Knight-Azyros soothes nearby allies. Opening it wide blinds the enemy with the full majesty of Sigmar’s light.

abilities.name: Herald of Redemption
abilities.description: Effect: If a friendly **RUINATION CHAMBER** unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the ‘Rally’ command, you receive 3 additional rally points.
abilities.lore: In Tornus, the troubled warriors of the Ruination chambers see a kindred spirit and heed his rallying call in battle.

units.lore: Tornus the Redeemed is living proof that even the most tainted souls are not beyond salvation. A former devotee of the Plague God, he now serves Sigmar with an unshakeable faith. Reforged as a Knight-Azyros, he has dedicated himself to providing some degree of succour to the troubled warriors of the Ruination chambers.

units.name: Karazai the Scarred

abilities.name: Calamitous Tail Sweep
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: With a sweep of his tail, Karazai can lay waste to enemy formations.

abilities.name: Fires of Retribution
abilities.description:
Effect: While this unit has 5-9 damage points, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons. 

While this unit has 10 or more damage points, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons instead.
abilities.lore: Vengeance burns blinding and everlasting in Karazai’s soul.

abilities.name: Ancient Master of War
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Karazai has seen countless battles over the heady span of his life, and the reptilian fury he displays can overpower any foe.

units.lore: Karazai does not so much lead Azyrite armies as simply arrive on the eve of battle. None would ever turn him away, though his draconic kin often find themselves unnerved by his spectacular shows of violence. He is capable of taking on entire enemy detachments alone, attacking without discrimination with jets of flame, cavernous jaws and great lashing tail alike.

units.name: Lord-Celestant on Stardrake

abilities.name: Cavernous Jaws
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll 3 dice. For each roll that equals or exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, 1 model in the target unit is slain.
abilities.lore: The enormous maw of a Stardrake can bite a foe in half.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Stardrake’s Cavernous Jaws** is 4.

abilities.name: Extremis Chamber
abilities.description: Effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Most scarce of Sigmar’s forces are the Extremis chambers, with each Stormcast mounted on a living weapon. To draw near these warriors is to risk being scoured by lightning or flame.

abilities.name: Lord of the Host
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of other friendly **EXTREMIS CHAMBER** units wholly within 12" of this unit for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Each Lord-Celestant is a renowned and respected leader – their very presence steels the souls of those under their command who fight nearby.

units.lore: The partnership of Stormcast and Stardrake is a potent force indeed upon the battlefield, both beings committed to holding off the collapse of order and sanity. Even the greater daemons of Chaos must be wary around a Lord-Celestant and their draconic ally, for they can annihilate any foe in a barrage of lightning-charged blows and summoned meteors.

units.name: Questor Soulsworn

abilities.name: His Will Be Done
abilities.description:
Effect: While this unit is contesting a questmarked objective:

• Add 3 to this unit’s control score.
• This unit has **WARD (5+)**.
abilities.lore: Questors will stop at nothing to fulfil the sacred task given to them by the God-King himself.

abilities.name: Ordained Quest
abilities.description: Effect: Pick an objective wholly outside friendly territory. That objective is considered by you to be questmarked.
abilities.lore: Questors travel deep into enemy territory to gain control of vital landmarks with hidden secrets.

abilities.name: Relictor Soulguide
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: You can pick a friendly **Knight‑Questor** within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, if you picked a target, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again within this unit’s combat range and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: The Knight-Relictor who accompanies the Soulsworn uses the winds of Sigmar’s Tempest to translocate the Questors to where they are most needed.

details.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.

units.lore: Stormcast Questors are typically solitary figures, carrying the burden of their divine missions alone, yet there are those labours so vital or challenging that even a Stormcast may not be able to complete them by themselves. In these instances, they are forged into gatherings of might known as Questor Soulsworn.

units.name: Prosecutors

abilities.name: Ruination Chamber
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-CORE ability
abilities.description: Effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.
abilities.lore: These veterans march where others cannot tread, fighting upon battlefields transformed into scenes of apocalypse. Even the most corrosive magics find no purchase on their souls.

abilities.name: Heralds of Righteousness
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.
abilities.lore: Prosecutors cross the battlefield in a blur of light.

abilities.name: Dispersed Formation
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".
abilities.lore: These warriors maintain a wide formation, enabling more precise strikes and greater battlefield control.

units.lore: Many legends sing of the shining angels known as Prosecutors. However, long gone are the radiant winged heralds of yore. As the clouds churn with Chaos corruption, ever more Prosecutors have found their sense of self eroding, necessitating their reassignment to the Ruination chambers.

units.name: Lord-Vigilant on Gryph-Stalker

abilities.name: Deliver Judgement
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO RUINATION CHAMBER** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: The target can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Lord-Vigilant orders their soul-hollowed brethren to deliver Sigmar's wrath unto their enemies.

abilities.name: Ruination Chamber
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-CORE ability
abilities.description: Effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.
abilities.lore: These veterans march where others cannot tread, fighting upon battlefields transformed into scenes of apocalypse. Even the most corrosive magics find no purchase on their souls.

units.lore: The Lord-Vigilants are the commanders and wardens of the Ruination chambers, who sequester their soul-stricken warriors away until the hour of the direst need. Much like their kin, their sense of self has begun to decay, but grim means allow them to maintain enough lucidity to command their brethren in battle.

units.name: Praetors

abilities.name: Soul-bonded
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS HERO** to be this unit’s soul-bonded charge for the rest of the battle. This unit can use this ability while it is in reserve.
abilities.lore: Praetors are exemplary bodyguards, linked to their assigned wards at an arcane, spiritual level.

abilities.name: Soul-forged Guardians
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit’s soul-bonded charge is within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and that soul-bonded charge have **WARD (5+)**.
abilities.lore: Praetors will protect their soul-bonded charges with every ounce of their being.

units.lore: The Praetors are the bodyguards of the Stormcast Eternals’ commanders. Their souls are practically entwined with those of their designated ward, allowing them to absorb their master’s wounds into their own flesh through mere physical contact, selflessly enduring while their lord fights on.

units.name: Stormcoven

abilities.name: Gather the Aether
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to this unit’s power level while it is contesting an objective.
abilities.lore: A Stormcoven can harness the aetheric energies from the ley lines that criss-cross the Mortal Realms, ready to be unleashed at a moment’s notice.

abilities.name: Aethershock
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible unit within 12" of the caster to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: If the target is a friendly unit, it has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn. If the target is an enemy unit, it has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Stormcoven unleash their stored energies across the battlefield, bolstering their allies or blasting enemies to the ground.

details.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.

units.lore: Stormcovens are elite strike teams of arcane specialists who often find themselves operating as part of a larger Stormcast army. Each of a Stormcoven’s Knight-Arcanums has mastered a particular school of celestial sorcery, and when they combine their talents, the effects are truly devastating.

units.name: Knight-Draconis

abilities.name: Arcane Heritage
abilities.phase: Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit or a friendly **Stormdrake Guard** unit wholly within 12" of this unit was picked to be the target of that spell, roll a dice. On a 4+, ignore the effect of that spell on this unit or that friendly unit. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per **SPELL** ability.
abilities.lore: Some exceptional Draconith are able to awaken their kind's innate resistance to magic within their broodmates.

abilities.name: Extremis Chamber
abilities.description: Effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Most scarce of Sigmar’s forces are the Extremis chambers, with each Stormcast mounted on a living weapon. To draw near these warriors is to risk being scoured by lightning or flame.

abilities.name: Wrath of the Draconith
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **Stormdrake Guard** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of both this unit’s and the target’s **Draconith’s Fangs and Talons** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: At their champion's command, the Stormdrake Guard bring to bear the full power of their mounts when the foe least expects it.

units.lore: Only one who has truly bonded with a Draconith can become a Knight-Draconis. Such unity is symbolised by the flaming blades these champions wield, and they eagerly bring burning death to any foe that stands before them.

units.name: Lord-Veritant

abilities.name: Ruination Chamber
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-CORE ability
abilities.description: Effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.
abilities.lore: These veterans march where others cannot tread, fighting upon battlefields transformed into scenes of apocalypse. Even the most corrosive magics find no purchase on their souls.

abilities.name: Staff of Abjuration
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use **UNBIND** abilities as if it had **WIZARD (1)**.
abilities.lore: The blessed light that shines from this staff can banish even the most potent sorceries.

abilities.name: Sense Unholy Sorcery
abilities.description:
Effect: This unit’s **Gryph-crow** is a token. Subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for enemy units within 12" of this unit while its **Gryph-crow** is on the battlefield.

If you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for this unit, remove its **Gryph-crow** from the battlefield after the **ATTACK** ability has been resolved (the damage point is still inflicted).
abilities.lore: Gryph‑crows are sensitive to corruption and immediately alert their masters whenever unholy energies are nearby.

units.lore: The Lord-Veritants are chosen from those whose hatred of Chaos eclipses all else. They have the uncanny ability to detect the merest sliver of corruption: a skill that has seen many reassigned to the Ruination chambers, where their assistance in monitoring warriors after exposure to the most hellish environment has proved invaluable.

units.name: Vanguard-Palladors with Shock Handaxes

abilities.name: Shocking Strikes
abilities.description: Effect: If any damage points are allocated to an enemy unit by attacks made with this unit’s **Shock Handaxes**, subtract 1 from wound rolls for that enemy unit’s combat attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Enemies struck with shock handaxes reel in pain as electricity courses through their veins.

abilities.name: Vanguard Chamber
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit can use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
abilities.lore: Through swiftness, guile and more than a hint of savagery, the warriors of the Vanguard chamber are able to outfight forces many times their own limited numbers.

units.lore: The Vanguard-Palladors are the Stormcast Eternals' elite skirmish cavalry, able to ride the winds aetheric to strike with great swiftness and accuracy. Those among their number who wield the shock handaxe over the starstrike javelin are better equipped for sustained engagements and sudden charges designed to scatter isolated formations.

units.name: Knight-Vexillor

abilities.name: The Banner of the Reforged
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to D3 friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Add 3 to each target’s control score for the rest of the turn. In addition, **Heal (D3)** each target.
abilities.lore: When the Knight-Vexillor plants their banner, the fortifying energy that emanates from it hardens flesh and seals sundered armour, empowering the faithful with new resolve.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Stormcast Exemplar*.

units.lore: Only the Knight-Vexillors are entrusted with the sacred standards of Azyr. Those known as Banners of Apotheosis are imbued with energies drawn from the great artefact upon which the Stormcast Eternals are remade; when such a standard is planted near to them, they are invigorated by the magic of the heavens.

units.name: Vandus Hammerhand

abilities.name: Lord of the Hammerhands
abilities.description: Effect: Add 3 to the control scores of friendly **WARRIOR CHAMBER** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Vandus is a mighty champion of the Hammers of Sigmar and a consummate commander.

abilities.name: Vengeance Unleashed
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO WARRIOR CHAMBER** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Vandus inspires nearby members of the Warrior chambers to strike forth and deliver justice in the God-King’s name.

units.lore: To Vandus’s warriors, he is still the same golden demigod as he was at the dawn of the Age of Sigmar. However, it is within this immortal shell that Vandus’s maddened soul is trapped, haunted by endless visions. As countless Reforgings slowly erode the last of his personhood, he dwells in his Stormhost’s Bleak Citadel between battles, watched closely by the Ruination chamber’s wardens.

units.name: Knight-Questor

abilities.name: His Will Be Done
abilities.description:
Effect: While this unit is contesting a questmarked objective:

• Add 3 to this unit’s control score.
• This unit has **WARD (5+)**.
abilities.lore: Questors will stop at nothing to fulfil the sacred task given to them by the God-King himself.

abilities.name: Ordained Quest
abilities.description: Effect: Pick an objective wholly outside friendly territory. That objective is considered by you to be questmarked.
abilities.lore: Questors travel deep into enemy territory to gain control of vital landmarks with hidden secrets.

abilities.name: Heroic Retribution
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly **Questor Soulsworn** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Should the need arise, the Knight-Questor will call upon their Soulsworn brethren to make the God-King’s justice a reality.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Stormcast Exemplar*.

units.lore: Standing apart from their fellow officers, the Knight-Questors are unburdened by the pressures of command; rather, these errant heroes possess more singular burdens. Each has been chosen by the God-King for a mission of the utmost import, and they will go to any lengths to see it done.

units.name: Vanguard-Raptors with Longstrike Crossbows

abilities.name: Headshot
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit has not used a **MOVE** ability this turn and was not set up this turn, for the rest of the turn, this unit can ignore the effects of the ‘Guarded Hero’ ability (Core Rules, 25.0) when picking targets for its shooting attacks.
abilities.lore: When given time to take careful aim, a Vanguard-Raptor can find their mark even amidst the roiling mass of battle.

abilities.name: Vanguard Chamber
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit can use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
abilities.lore: Through swiftness, guile and more than a hint of savagery, the warriors of the Vanguard chamber are able to outfight forces many times their own limited numbers.

units.lore: Raining death upon the enemy from afar, Vanguard-Raptors armed with longstrike crossbows are marksmen with few equals. They often seek to eliminate enemy leaders and champions, spreading panic and disorder through the foe's ranks with carefully chosen kills.

units.name: Aetherwings

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: Marked for Destruction
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made by friendly **VANGUARD CHAMBER** units if the target is within 9" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Those who oppose the masters of these loyal beasts hear doom approaching in the beating of celestial wings.

units.lore: Said to be swifter than the winds themselves, Aetherwings are often found racing across the skies in shimmering flocks or circling above their Vanguard allies, descending upon any who would menace the Stormcasts in a flurry of razor‑sharp talons.

units.name: Reclusians

abilities.name: Ruination Chamber
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-CORE ability
abilities.description: Effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.
abilities.lore: These veterans march where others cannot tread, fighting upon battlefields transformed into scenes of apocalypse. Even the most corrosive magics find no purchase on their souls.

abilities.name: Memorian Descendants
abilities.description:
Effect: This unit’s **Memorians** are tokens. There are 2 **Memorians** for every 3 models in this unit. While any of this unit’s **Memorians** are on the battlefield, add 1 to this unit’s resistance rolls when using the ‘Ruination Chamber’ ability.

Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for this unit, remove 1 of its **Memorians** from the battlefield after the **ATTACK** ability has been resolved (the damage point is still inflicted).
abilities.lore: Reclusians are accompanied by Memorians who serve to remind them of their humanity.

units.lore: The Reclusians are warriors of the Ruination chambers, their identities eroded by countless Reforgings over centuries in service to God-King. Though they are close to becoming more engine of war than human, their lightning-scoured souls are particularly resistant to Chaos as a result, allowing them to tread where no other servant of Sigmar could hope to survive.

units.name: Iridan the Witness

abilities.name: Prayer of the Witness
abilities.description:
Declare: Make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, each time a friendly **RUINATION CHAMBER** unit uses a **FIGHT** ability while it is wholly within 18" of this unit, after that ability has been resolved:

• **Heal (D3)** that unit. If the chanting roll was 8+, **Heal (3)** that unit instead.
• That unit has **WARD (6+)** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Iridan serves as a beacon of light that guides the souls of those in the Ruination chambers, giving their actions purpose and calming the storm that churns within each of them.

abilities.name: Ruination Chamber
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked as the target of a non-Core ability
abilities.description: Effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 4+, that ability has no effect on this unit.
abilities.lore: These veterans march where others cannot tread, fighting upon battlefields transformed into scenes of apocalypse. Even the most corrosive magics find no purchase on their souls.

abilities.name: Dark Flight
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic:

• 1 model in the target unit is slain.
• This unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability without any mortal damage being inflicted upon it.
abilities.lore: A hapless foe is crushed in the talons of Ariax before the Morrgryph takes flight once more with a beat of their ebon wings.

units.lore: Iridan the Witness is determined to preserve the memory of the Ruination chambers’ warriors as they once were, before the nightmare of the flaw and the slow degradation of their souls. Through the power of remembrance and the shattering power of their martial might, the Witness will fight for those who have sacrificed everything in the name of the God-King. Accompanying them on this sombre journey is the mighty Morrgryph Ariax, a deadly beast who bears the favour of the Bleak Raven.

units.name: Gryph-hounds

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: Warning Cry
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit within 12" of this unit that was set up this turn. Then, pick up to 3 friendly **STORMCAST ETERNALS** units armed with ranged weapons that are within 12" of that enemy unit to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that enemy unit equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: It is said that it is impossible to sneak up on a Gryph-hound.

units.lore: Gryph-hounds have senses as sharp as their retractable claws and heavy, hooked beaks. These nimble quadrupeds are possessed of a noble disposition and an innate hatred of Chaos, and they will ferociously attack on sight anyone or anything tainted by the Dark Gods.

units.name: Lord-Aquilor

abilities.name: Vanguard Chamber
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description: Effect: For the rest of the turn, this unit can use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
abilities.lore: Through swiftness, guile and more than a hint of savagery, the warriors of the Vanguard chamber are able to outfight forces many times their own limited numbers.

abilities.name: Ride The Winds Aetheric
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is not in combat, you can pick up to 2 friendly **VANGUARD-PALLADORS** units that are not in combat to be the targets.

Effect: Remove this unit and the targets (if any) from the battlefield. Set this unit up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up each target wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Gryph-chargers can move faster than the eye can follow along the winds aetheric.

units.lore: The Lord-Aquilors are the leaders of the Vanguard Auxiliary chambers, hunters and warriors both who ride ahead of the Stormhosts to deliver an arrow-swift assault. Keen of eye and wit alike, they are capable of enacting blisteringly swift hit-and-run assaults thanks to the winds aetheric, magical currents that surge unseen across the realms.

units.name: Drakesworn Templar

abilities.name: Extremis Chamber
abilities.description: Effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Most scarce of Sigmar’s forces are the Extremis chambers, with each Stormcast mounted on a living weapon. To draw near these warriors is to risk being scoured by lightning or flame.

abilities.name: Monstrous Challenge
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, for the rest of the turn:

• Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Stardrake’s Cavernous Jaws** for attacks that target that enemy **MONSTER**.
• If that enemy **MONSTER** is also a **HERO**, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s **Templar Weapon** for attacks that target that unit.
abilities.lore: Though not strictly holding the rank of knight, the Drakesworn Templars fulfil a similar role within the Extremis chambers, charging off to face the greatest threats in single combat.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Stardrake’s Cavernous Jaws** is 4.

units.lore: When they are not manning the Drakesworn Temples of their Stormhost, the Drakesworn Templars fight as martial champions alongside their Lord‑Celestant. Such is their skill and the cosmic might of their mounts that they are able to overwhelm entire sections of the enemy’s battleline on their own, the Stardrakes incinerating foes with cascades of fire and lightning even as their riders send forth celestial blasts from their skybolt bows.

units.name: Annihilators

abilities.name: Blazing Impact
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit was set up this turn using the ‘Scions of the Storm’ ability, pick up to 3 enemy units within 10" of it to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Annihilators arrive upon the field with devastating force, twin tailed trails streaking behind them as an earth-shattering shock-wave blasts apart the foes of Sigmar.

abilities.name: Brace for Impact
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice for each model in this unit. If any of the rolls are a 6, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Annihilators brace behind their mighty shields to hold off even the most ferocious charge.

units.lore: Wielding hammers and shields hewn from enchanted meteoric rock, Annihilators are sometimes held to be unkillable. They do not descend from the heavens but emerge horizontally through rifts of crackling lightning, and their brutal momentum is a weapon in itself.

units.name: Lord-Celestant

abilities.name: Furious Retribution
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly non-**HERO WARRIOR CHAMBER INFANTRY** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Lord‑Celestants lead their brethren in assaults upon the enemy lines, breaking the foe beneath their immortal fury.

units.lore: The Lord-Celestants are all cunning tacticians, ferocious fighters and formidably effective leaders. To the people of the realms, they are the avenging hand of the heavens walking amongst them; to their warriors, they are lieges who shoulder the unimaginable burden of choosing where their kin shall endure another death.

units.name: Dracothian Guard Concussors (1 model)

abilities.name: Thunderstruck
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: When a lightning hammer finds its mark, enemies are paralysed by crackling energy and a flash of blinding light.

abilities.name: Extremis Chamber
abilities.description: Effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Most scarce of Sigmar’s forces are the Extremis chambers, with each Stormcast mounted on a living weapon. To draw near these warriors is to risk being scoured by lightning or flame.

details.notes: You can include 1 unit of this type for each **Lord‑Celestant on Dracoth** in your army.

units.lore: Thunder cracks with every weighty blow delivered by the Concussors. Those foes not slain outright by bludgeoning strikes are battered into submission, stunned by the azure shockwaves released by those resounding impacts.

units.name: Knight-Arcanum

abilities.name: Indomitable Loreseekers
abilities.description:
Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit when it uses a **SUMMON** ability and add 1 to banishment rolls for this unit.

Enemy **MANIFESTATIONS** cannot pass through or end any move within this unit’s combat range unless they started that move within this unit’s combat range.

This unit has **WARD (4+)** against mortal damage inflicted by **MANIFESTATIONS**.
abilities.lore: The thick tomes carried by Knight-Arcanums are filled with the magical secrets they have learnt, including how to resist the raging sorcerous energies of the realms.

units.lore: A Knight-Arcanum is an arcane warrior privy to secrets beyond the ken of their martial-minded comrades. Their consciousness expanded by the Hyshian gemstones embedded in their wargear, the Knight-Arcanums unleash storms of celestial fury upon their foes, slamming them with stunning cosmic winds or deadly hails of razor-sharp ice.

units.name: Dracothian Guard Tempestors (1 model)

abilities.name: Extremis Chamber
abilities.description: Effect: Each time you make an unmodified save roll of 6 for a combat attack that targets this unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Most scarce of Sigmar’s forces are the Extremis chambers, with each Stormcast mounted on a living weapon. To draw near these warriors is to risk being scoured by lightning or flame.

abilities.name: Overwhelming Volleystorm
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by attacks made with this unit’s **Volleystorm Crossbows** to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, the target cannot use the ‘All-out Defence’ command in the following combat phase.
abilities.lore: The Tempestors fire charged crossbow bolts into the foe, weakening their defences and leaving them open to a follow-up assault.

details.notes: You can include 1 unit of this type for each **Lord‑Celestant on Dracoth** in your army.

units.lore: While their Dracoths charge forward spitting lightning, the Tempestors unleash the fury of their volleystorm crossbows, loosing a hail of bolts that burn like blazing meteorites. They can concentrate their fire to fell powerful foes or blast holes in enemy lines for other Dracothian Guard to exploit.

units.name: Stormstrike Chariot

abilities.name: Azyr Unleashed
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: The impact of a Stormstrike Chariot on the charge can obliterate even the most durable of shieldwalls.

abilities.name: Celestial Blaze
abilities.description: Effect: When this unit uses the ‘Power Through’ command, inflict an additional D3 mortal damage on the target and add D6" to the distance this unit can move as part of that ability.
abilities.lore: The Stormstrike Chariot smashes through lesser foes in a blaze of celestial power.

units.lore: Swift war-carriages of the Angelos conclaves, Stormstrike Chariots are potent linebreakers. As they build up speed, they draw the energies of Azyr to themselves before unleashing them in thunderous blasts amidst the enemy ranks.

units.name: Stormdrake Guard

abilities.name: Dispersed Formation
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a coherency range of 2".
abilities.lore: These warriors maintain a wide formation, enabling more precise strikes and greater battlefield control.

Then, pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across during that move. Inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.
abilities.lore: To reclaim their old empire, the Draconith and their riders fight together as a single furious whole, savaging any who cross their path.

units.lore: The Stormdrake Guard are the result of the alliance between Azyr and the Draconith. In battle, they are holy terrors, the Stormcasts fighting with consummate skill while the drakes' burning breath and vicious claws annihilate their foes.

units.name: Vindictors

abilities.name: Hold the Shieldwall
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit did not charge this turn and is in combat with an enemy unit that charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 4+, this unit has **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Vindictor retinues form the unyielding shieldwalls upon which the forces of ruin shatter.

units.lore: Vindictors were amongst the first Stormcasts to be equipped with thunderstrike armour, their wargear designed by Grungni to defend against even the most aggressive enemy assaults. They are the shieldwall upon which the forces of ruin shatter. Forged from the most unrelenting souls, Vindictors will endure come what may and spit defiance until the last.

units.name: Liberators

abilities.name: Stalwart Defenders
abilities.description: Effect: Add 3 to this unit’s control score while it is contesting an objective wholly within friendly territory.
abilities.lore: Liberators fiercely guard the lands brought into Sigmar’s domain.

units.lore: The Liberators are the backbone of the God-King’s battlelines, trained to both enact sudden assaults and form unbreakable shieldwalls. To them falls the duty of casting down the warlords of ruin and stamping Sigmar’s claim upon the lands once more.

units.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Iridan the Witness

abilities.name: Demands of the Witness
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **RUINATION CHAMBER** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.

Effect: If the chanting roll was 7+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of each target’s melee weapons.
abilities.lore: Iridan understands better than any that the most assured way to avoid the incremental erosion of the flaw in the Reforging process is to avoid being cut down, and so they exhort their charges to vanquish their foes quickly, mercilessly and without hesitation.

abilities.name: The Flames of Hope
abilities.description: Effect: You can re-roll resistance rolls for friendly **RUINATION CHAMBER** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The billowing flames borne by Iridan are instantly recognisable by all of Sigmar’s greatest warriors, even those who have lost nearly every part of themselves in his name.

abilities.name: On Wings of Death
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect:  If the target charged this turn, apply the effects below. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effects below:

• You can remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again within 1" of the target.
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Ariax swoops over the heads of the foe, robbing them of their will to fight.

abilities.name: Guardian of the Final Threshold
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: This unit was picked to be the target of a non-**CORE** ability
abilities.description: Effect: Make a resistance roll of D6. On a 3+, that ability has no effect on this unit.
abilities.lore: Iridan does battle where others cannot tread, fighting in lands transformed into scenes of apocalypse. Even the most corrosive magics find no purchase on this shepherd of lost souls, their faith granting them near immunity to such impurities.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

units.lore: Able to endure the horrors of the Gnaw for far longer than their brethren, Iridan the Witness leads the Stormcasts of the Ruination chambers into battle with the resurgent Skaven in the easternmost Great Parch. Champion of the death god Morrda, they ride atop the Morrgryph Ariax and seek to reawaken their companions’ memories of past glories.

units.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Stormstrike Palladors

abilities.name: Lightning Quick
abilities.description: Effect: No mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **RETREAT** abilities.
abilities.lore: One of the swiftest and most agile mounts in the realms, Gryph-chargers deftly speed their riders away from danger.

abilities.name: Shock Cavalry
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with both of the following units to be the target:
• This unit.
• A friendly unit that did not charge this turn.

Effect: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for attacks that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Stormstrike Palladors are masters at performing devastating charges into the unguarded flanks of enemies already engaged in combat.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

units.lore: The hard-hitting cavalry of the Warrior chambers, Stormstrike Palladors are outfitted not solely to administer a devastating charge but also to engage in extended periods of melee fighting in which their heavy blades and the talons of their Gryph-chargers prove most effective killing tools.

battleTraits.name: Swift Tide
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Battle Round, Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you used the ‘Concealing Tide’ ability in the previous battle round and you have not used any other **TIDAL** abilities this battle round.

Effect: For the rest of the battle round, friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units can use Run abilities and still use Shoot and/or Charge abilities later in the turn.
battleTraits.lore: The sheer rapidity of the sea’s advance sees the Idoneth outpace their foes.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Idoneth Deepkin armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Sea's Embrace
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Battle Round, Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you used the ‘Swift Tide’ ability in the previous battle round and you have not used any other **TIDAL** abilities this battle round.

Effect: Friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units have **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
battleTraits.lore: Those engulfed by the vast ocean can do nothing but await their fate.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Idoneth Deepkin armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Concealing Tide
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Battle Round, Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you did not use it in the previous battle round and you have not used any other **TIDAL** abilities this battle round.

Effect: For the rest of the battle round, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units that did not use any **CHARGE** abilities in the same turn.
battleTraits.lore: Freezing and impenetrable mists descend across the battlefield.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Idoneth Deepkin armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Storm's Wrath
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Battle Round, Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you used the ‘Inexorable Tide’ ability in the previous battle round and you have not used any other **TIDAL** abilities this battle round.

Effect: Friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units’ melee weapons have **Crit (Mortal)** for the rest of the turn.
battleTraits.lore: Woe to those caught in the path of the storm’s destructive fury.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Idoneth Deepkin armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Inexorable Tide
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Battle Round, Any Hero Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: You can only use this ability if you used the ‘Unpredictable Tide’ ability in the previous battle round and you have not used any other **TIDAL** abilities this battle round.

Effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units for the rest of the battle round.
battleTraits.lore: When the tide sweeps in, no force of nature or magic can keep it at bay.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Idoneth Deepkin armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.lore: Only the Deepkin can anticipate the mercurial currents of the ocean.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Idoneth Deepkin armies can use the following abilities:

•  If this unit used a **SHOOT** ability, immediately after the **SHOOT** ability used by this unit has been resolved, the target can be picked to use a **SHOOT** ability as if it were your shooting phase.

•  If this unit used a **FIGHT** ability, immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved, the target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability. If the target does so, for the rest of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its weapons but all of its attacks must target enemy units that had any damage points allocated to it this phase by this unit’s attacks.
battleTraits.lore: Though the Idoneth’s military structure is uncompromisingly rigid, their fluidity in battle is astounding. The Akhelians lead; the Namarti follow. Such discipline, alloyed to aelven speed and grace, has spelled the doom of numberless foes.

ability.description: Effect: You can re-roll run rolls and charge rolls for friendly **NAMARTI** units while they are wholly within 12" of a friendly **AKHELIAN** unit.
ability.lore: The Namarti are the lowest caste in Idoneth society, but when formed into a Namarti Corps and led to battle by their Akhelian masters, they strike swiftly and with devastating effect.

heroicTraits.name: Form of the Fangmora
heroicTraits.description: Effect: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-3, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.
heroicTraits.lore: This champion has mastered a defensive sword-art that mimics the fluid movements of the swift Fangmora Eels.

heroicTraits.name: Hunter of Souls
heroicTraits.description:
Effect: Pick 1 of the following weapon abilities for this unit’s melee weapons to have this battle:
•  **Anti-CAVALRY (+1 Rend)**
•  **Anti-INFANTRY (+1 Rend)**
•  **Anti-MONSTER (+1 Rend)**
heroicTraits.lore: This hero seeks neither glory nor territory; their only interest is the capture of potent soul-stuff.

heroicTraits.name: Nightmare Legacy
heroicTraits.description: Effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units while they are within 6" of this unit.
heroicTraits.lore: The repressed horror of the Idoneth’s long incarceration emanates from this dark-visaged warrior in palpable waves of doom.

heroicTraits.name: Abyssal Dweller
heroicTraits.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
heroicTraits.description:
Declare: Pick an objective within 18" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the battle, while enemy units are contesting the target objective:
• Subtract the current battle round number from those units’ Move characteristic.
• Those units cannot use **RUN**, **RETREAT** or **CHARGE** abilities.
heroicTraits.lore: Hailing from the lightless depths, this champion can manipulate the ethersea so as to plunge areas into total darkness.

heroicTraits.name: Cursed Lineage
heroicTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to your opponent’s **fury level**. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
heroicTraits.lore: This Idoneth channels the profound despair once felt by the Cythai and reflects it back at the foe, causing soul-deep wounds.

heroicTraits.name: Adherent of Kir-Nadarr
heroicTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: You can spend 1 **rage dice**. If you do:
• Apply the effect below.
• If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.

For the rest of the turn, ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units that target that enemy unit.
heroicTraits.lore: This Idoneth has embraced the bellicose Way of the Storm, and so too do their warriors seek to embody the surging force of destruction.

artefacts.name: Lifekelp Pod
artefacts.description: Effect: **Heal (D3)** each friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN CAVALRY** unit within this unit’s combat range.
artefacts.lore: Radiant with Ghyranite energy, this golden seed pod bursts in a spray of vital power.

artefacts.name: Dritchleech
artefacts.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from casting rolls for enemy **WIZARDS** while they are within 18" of this unit. In addition, each time an enemy spell fails, after that ability has been resolved, **Heal (1)** this unit.
artefacts.lore: Incredibly rare, these worms feed upon magic and are capable of draining arcane energies.

artefacts.name: Armour of the Cythai
artefacts.description: Effect: If this unit has not charged this turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.
artefacts.lore: This gleaming panoply was given by Teclis to the ancestors of the Idoneth. Upon the command of its bearer, it can radiate the power of Hysh – a fitting property for a gift from the Great Illuminator.

aqshyEnhancements.name: Ironshell Barnacles
aqshyEnhancements.description:
Effect: • If this unit is **INFANTRY**, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target it.

• If this unit is **CAVALRY**, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target it.

• If this unit is a **MONSTER**, ignore negative modifiers to run rolls and charge rolls for it.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: Attaching themselves to hides and armour, the extra durability granted by these crustaceans is welcomed.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText:
Ethersea Companions are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO IDONETH DEEPKIN** units.
A unit can only have 1 Ethersea Companion.

aqshyEnhancements.name: Stonefoot Anemone
aqshyEnhancements.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use **MOVE** abilities for the rest of the turn.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: The toxins in this creature’s sting render foes briefly immobile.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText:
Ethersea Companions are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO IDONETH DEEPKIN** units.
A unit can only have 1 Ethersea Companion.

aqshyEnhancements.name: Aqshian Sea Nettles
aqshyEnhancements.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit and that charged this turn to be the target.

Effect: Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.

Then, for the rest of the turn:
• Other enemy units cannot use **FIGHT** abilities if the target is eligible to be picked.
• If possible, this unit must be picked to be the target of pile-in moves made by the target.
• All attacks made by models in the target unit within this unit’s combat range must target this unit.

**Designer’s Note**: *This ability does not override the* **STRIKE-FIRST** *or* **STRIKE-LAST** *constraints.*
aqshyEnhancements.lore: Floating around their owners, these jellyfish instinctively lash out at nearby foes, causing panic and confusion.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText:
Ethersea Companions are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO IDONETH DEEPKIN** units.
A unit can only have 1 Ethersea Companion.

spells.name: Pressure of the Deep
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
spells.lore: The wizard enfolds their victims in a shimmering bubble of crushing force.

spells.name: Steed of Tides
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** unit wholly within 12" of them and not in combat to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
spells.lore: The wizard conjures an agile elemental to transport comrades through the ethersea.

spells.name: Counter-Current
spells.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN WIZARD** to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, halve run rolls and charge rolls for the target.
spells.lore: The wizard summons a powerful current to hold their enemies at bay.

manifestations.name: Incarnate of the Deep

abilities.name: Wild Form
abilities.description: Effect: Each time this **MANIFESTATION** is targeted by the ‘Banish Manifestation’ ability, if it would be banished, it is not banished. Instead, allocate 6 damage points to it (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
abilities.lore: This manifestation is notoriously wilful, resisting any effort by sorcerers to tame or banish it.

abilities.name: Grasping Tendrils
abilities.description:
Effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if it is your turn. On a 4+:

•  You can remove 1 friendly **ABYSSAL TENDRIL**  from the battlefield.
•  If there are fewer than 2 friendly **Abyssal Tendrils** on the battlefield, you can set up an **ABYSSAL TENDRIL**  wholly within 9" of this **MANIFESTATION**.
abilities.lore: The Incarnate reaches out across the ethersea to conjure tendrils of freezing, coiling water.

abilities.name: Surrender to the Sea
abilities.description: Effect: When this **MANIFESTATION** is removed from play, each friendly **ABYSSAL TENDRIL**  on the battlefield is automatically removed from play.
abilities.lore: If the Incarnate is driven back from the enemy, its tendrils slink back into the ethersea too.

manifestations.lore: Conjured through elemental ritual and empowered by the spirits of the ocean, an Incarnate of the Deep is a ship-breaking tempest given physical form. Reaching out with serpent-like appendages, it seizes its prey and draws them inexorably in, drowning them within its turbulent mass.

summonSpell.name: Summon Incarnate of the Deep
summonSpell.description:
Declare: If there is not a friendly **Incarnate of the Deep** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN WIZARD** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Set up an **Incarnate of the Deep** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
summonSpell.lore: The spellcaster awakens a terrifying manifestation of the ocean’s wrath.
