terrain.name: Gloomtide Shipwreck

abilities.name: Phantasmal Ruin
abilities.description:
Effect: Models can pass through this terrain feature but cannot be set up on or end moves on any part of this terrain feature.

Each time an enemy unit ends a move that passed through or across this terrain feature, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Gloomtide Shipwrecks are apparitions of sunken vessels filled with ethereal creatures that strike out at those who stray too close.

abilities.name: Rise From The Depths
abilities.description:
Declare: This ability must be used instead of the ‘Deploy Faction Terrain’ ability.

Effect: Set up this faction terrain either as 1 terrain feature consisting of 2 scenery pieces (that must be set up within 3" of each other) or as 2 separate terrain features. Set up each terrain feature wholly within friendly territory and more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features. After you have done so, it has been deployed.

If this faction terrain is set up as 1 terrain feature consisting of 2 scenery pieces, it has a Health characteristic of 14 instead of 7.
abilities.lore: Ancient wreckages adrift in the great currents of the ethersea provide a haven for Idoneth.

abilities.name: Guardians of the Deep
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to save rolls for friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN INFANTRY** and **CAVALRY** units while they are wholly within 6" of this terrain feature.
abilities.lore: Shoals of small sea creatures infest this wreck, instinctively swarming out to shield Idoneth Deepkin that are nearby.

terrain.lore: A Gloomtide Shipwreck is a supernatural manifestation in the ethersea, a barnacle-encrusted ruin swarming with vicious deep-sea creatures that provides nearby Idoneth with cover from which to launch their attacks.

units.name: Akhelian King

weapons.name: Deepmare’s Fangs, Talons and Lashing Tails

abilities.name: Crest of the Wave
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit charged this turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by other friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units for attacks that target enemy units in combat with this unit.
abilities.lore: Riding the momentum of the ethersea, the Akhelian King leads a glorious charge to shatter the enemy ranks.

abilities.name: Wave Rider
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+:

• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s **Akhelian Royal Weapons** for attacks that target that enemy unit for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: When an Akhelian King charges the foe, they hit with the power of a crashing wave.

units.lore: Akhelian Kings are the war leaders of the Idoneth enclaves. Mounted atop fierce and intelligent Deepmares, these inspiring commanders fight at the forefront of every battle, urging their Phalanxes forward as they wield their blades with deadly skill.

units.name: Lotann, Warden of the Soul Ledgers

abilities.name: Empowered By Memory
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** unit wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: The target’s melee weapons have **Crit (Auto-wound)** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Lotann draws on the accumulated memories of his people to grant his allies supernatural strength and resolve.

abilities.name: Catalogue of Souls
abilities.description: Effect: Each time an enemy unit is destroyed, give this unit a **soul‑quota token**.
abilities.lore: The Soul Wardens keep records of the souls that are harvested by the phalanxes.

abilities.name: Fount of Willpower
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn, Reaction: You declared a **SPELL** ability for a friendly **ISHARANN** unit wholly within 12" of this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Remove 1 of this unit’s **soul-quota tokens**. Then, you can re‑roll the casting roll.
abilities.lore: Such is Lotann’s obsessive commitment to his duty that his willpower bleeds out into the ethersea, a potent magical force that can be drawn upon to empower his fellow Isharann.

units.lore: Lotann is the Warden of the Soul Ledgers, whose task it is to oversee the reaping of spirit-essences across the enclaves. A skilled arcanist in his own right, Lotann channels the gestalt memories of the Idoneth to empower his kin.

units.name: Akhelian Ishlaen Guard

abilities.name: Galv-shields
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has **WARD (5+)** if it charged in the same turn.
abilities.lore: Thanks to their protective aura, the Ishlaen have greater staying power in prolonged combat than their spear-armed kin.

abilities.name: Biovoltaic Barrier
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target unit’s weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The biovoltaic energy produced by Fangmora Eels is channelled by Ishlaen Guard into a crackling luminescent energy field that protects them from harm.

units.lore: Ishlaen Guard channel the bioelectricity of Fangmora mounts into their galv-shields, manifesting this energy as a sparking field that turns aside enemy blows. Thanks to this protective aura, the Ishlaen are often assigned as the bodyguards of Akhelian Kings or other high-ranking Idoneth, seeking the closest threats and laying them low with sweeps of their helsabres.

units.name: Akhelian Morrsarr Guard

abilities.name: Biovoltaic Blast
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the number of models in this unit. Add 1 to each roll if there are more models in the target unit than this unit. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: The biovoltaic energy produced by Fangmora Eels is stored by Morrsarr Guard, ready to be discharged as a bolt of energy when the time is right.

units.lore: Armed with voltspears and galv-shields, the Morrsarr Guard function as heavy shock cavalry, their fearsome weapons channelling the powerful electrical energy given off by the Fangmoras. This shockwave is loosed moments before the Morrsarr crash into the enemy, blasting the front ranks even as the Akhelians’ spears strike home.

units.name: Akhelian Thrallmaster

abilities.name: Akhelian Insights
abilities.description: Effect: Melee weapons used by friendly **NAMARTI** units have **Crit (2 Hits)** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Thrallmasters are cunning and sea-scarred Akhelians who lead the Namarti hosts into battle. Master duellists skilled with all manner of exotic weaponry, they scythe through their foes with contemptuous ease.

abilities.name: Thrallmaster
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly **NAMARTI THRALLS** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved.
abilities.lore: Thrallmasters are cunning and sea-scarred Akhelians who lead the Namarti hosts into battle.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Akhelian Raidmaster*.

units.lore: Thrallmasters are cunning and sea-scarred Akhelians who lead the Namarti hosts into battle. Master duellists skilled with all manner of exotic weaponry, they scythe through their foes with contemptuous ease.

units.name: Namarti Thralls

abilities.name: Sweeping Blows
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: If any damage points inflicted by attacks made as part of that **FIGHT** ability are allocated to any enemy units, subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks made by those enemy units for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: A Namarti Thrall’s aggressive swiping strikes are intended to knock their enemies off their feet.

units.lore: The core infantry of the Idoneth Deepkin, Namarti Thralls advance into battle brandishing vast two-handed weapons known as lanmari. Despite their blindness and the heft of their blades, they whirl and chop with aelven grace.

units.name: Akhelian Leviadon

weapons.name: Leviadon’s Scythed Fins and Crushing Jaws

abilities.name: Crushing Charge
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy **INFANTRY** unit within 1" of it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. Add 1 to the roll if the target unit has more than 10 models. On a 3+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: When a Leviadon charges into battle, it crushes the foe with its sheer mass.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Leviadon’s Scythed Fins and Crushing Jaws** is 5.

abilities.name: Void Drum
abilities.description: Effect: Friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units have **WARD (5+)** while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.
abilities.lore: A void drummer rides on the back of every Akhelian Leviadon. The mesmerising rhythm that they beat out sends rippling currents through the air, distorting the outlines of the drummer’s comrades and making them hard to see.

units.lore: A monstrous undersea titan, the Leviadon is covered in thick scales and protected by an impenetrable shell. In addition to its powerful jaws and bladed fins, it carries a hard-bitten crew and twin harpoon launchers, making it a veritable living fortress.

units.name: Eidolon of Mathlann, Aspect of the Sea

abilities.name: Dormant Energies
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls for this unit.
abilities.lore: The Isharann aspect of an Eidolon of Mathlann seethes with suppressed energies that it can draw upon at need.

abilities.name: Tranquillity of the Abyss
abilities.description: Effect: Ignore negative modifiers to the control scores of friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: An Eidolon in its aspect of the sea radiates an aura of unnatural tranquillity, calming any fears that nearby Idoneth may harbour.

abilities.name: Tsunami of Terror
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 different visible enemy units within 12" of this unit to be the targets, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Subtract 1 from save rolls for combat attacks that target those units until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: With a wave of its sceptre, the Eidolon sends forth invisible waves of fear that cause even the bravest of opponents to cower.

abilities.name: Vengeful Waves
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit has not charged this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: When threatened, the Eidolon causes the ethersea to crash around it, overwhelming its enemies.

units.lore: An Eidolon of Mathlann is a mystical conjuration that embodies a long-forgotten god. When summoned in its aspect of the sea, this entity can call upon the magic of the ocean to bolster allies or send enemies fleeing in terror.

units.name: Isharann Soulrender

abilities.name: Lurelight
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 different friendly **NAMARTI** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets. You cannot pick the same unit to be the target of this ability more than once per turn.

Effect: Make a lurelight roll of D3 for each target unit. On a 2+, return a number of slain models to the target unit equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Isharann Soulrenders possess a mystical lure that is used to draw unto them the souls of slain opponents so that they can be captured. Should the Soulrender act quickly enough, the stolen essence can be repurposed to resurrect fallen Namarti mid-battle.

abilities.name: Hangman's Knot
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, it is automatically destroyed.
abilities.lore: The noose on a talúnhook can be used to ensnare a victim, ensuring they cannot escape their doom at the hands of the Soulrender.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Isharann Emissary*.

units.lore: Unlike the rest of their Isharann kin, Soulrenders fight face to face with their foes, reaping spirit-matter with every swing of their scythe-like talúnhooks. In battle, they can channel their mystical powers to revive fallen Namarti.

units.name: Scourge of Ghyran Namarti Thralls

abilities.name: Hit-and-Run Tactics
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is in combat or charged this turn, this unit can make a pile-in move. Then, if this unit is in combat, you must pick 1 or more enemy units to be the target(s) of this unit’s attacks.

Effect: Resolve combat attacks against the target unit(s). Then, if this unit is in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move a distance up to its Move characteristic. It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of that move. It does not have to end the move in combat.
abilities.lore: The Namarti Thralls strike at their foes before using the ethersea to fall back to a safer position.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.

units.lore: Namarti Thralls have proved as skilled in waging strike-and-fade war amidst the jungles of Ghyran as they are in the kelp forests of their undersea home. Enhanced by the ethersea, their extrasensory powers allow them to isolate their prey, lashing out with their lanmari blades before retreating into the shadows under the cover of briny mists.

units.name: Isharann Tidecaster

abilities.name: Master of the Ethersea
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Make an Isharann ritual roll of D6.

Effect: On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn:

***Creeping Mist:*** Friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units cannot be targeted by shooting attacks unless the attacking model is within 12" of them.

***Surging Stream:*** Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units.

***Spiteful Riptide:*** Each time an enemy unit uses a **RETREAT** ability, after the effect of that ability has been resolved, inflict D3 mortal damage on that unit.
abilities.lore: A Tidecaster can manipulate the ethersea like no other.

units.lore: Isharann Tidecasters are the Idoneth’s most potent frontline wizards, capable of directing the surging currents of the ethersea in order to alter the momentum of battle or to steal the very breath from their foes.

units.name: Ikon of the Storm

abilities.name: Whirlpool's Fury
abilities.description:
Effect: Enemy units cannot use **RETREAT** abilities while they are in combat with this unit.

Friendly units that use a **RETREAT** ability while they are wholly within 12" of this unit can still use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.

No mortal damage is inflicted on friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units by **RETREAT** abilities while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: An Ikon of the Storm is a vortex of rage, overwhelming enemies and inspiring their kin to fight ever harder.

abilities.name: Storm of Blades
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Channelling the frothing violence of a maelstrom, the Ikon of the Storm lashes out again and again.

details.notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as an *Akhelian Raidmaster*.

units.lore: Ikons of the Storm aim to embody the destructive force of a raging ocean. Wielding twin blades, they hurl themselves into battle, heedless of any personal danger as they carve their enemies apart. Foes are helpless in the face of the Ikon’s whirling maelstrom of steel, and those with a mind to flee are cut down before they can take a single step.

units.name: Isharann Soulscryer

abilities.name: Finder of Ways
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared the ‘Unpredictable Tide’ ability or the ‘Steed of Tides’ ability
abilities.description: Effect: Instead of setting up the targets as described in the ability used, set them up on the battlefield wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 7" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Soulscryers are the Idoneth’s navigators, helping them divine hidden paths through the realmseas.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Isharann Emissary*.

units.lore: Soulscryers work their strange magics to navigate the utter darkness of the deep places. Their eldritch senses allow them to guide other Idoneth along hidden paths in the realms’ oceans and rivers, so that they can strike the foe from unexpected angles.

units.name: Mathaela, Oracle of the Abyss

abilities.name: Crushing Pressure
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: Roll a number of dice equal to the target’s Health characteristic, to a maximum of 10. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: Mathaela subjects their foes to the devastating pressure of the deepest trenches, causing bones to shatter and metal to crumple like paper.

abilities.name: Siren Song of the Abyss
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets’ **Companion** weapons.
abilities.lore: More attuned to the heartbeat of the ocean than any Isharann, Mathaela can stir the seas to thrashing life with but a gesture.

units.lore: Mysterious and terrifying, the Oracle of the Abyss only rises from their lightless domain when the existence of the Deepkin is threatened. Wielding the crushing magic of the deepest ocean planes, Mathaela annihilates the Idoneth’s foes and stirs the very realmseas into violent motion.

units.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Isharann Tidecaster

abilities.name: Master of the Ethersea
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: If the target is **NAMARTI**, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn. Otherwise, make an Isharann ritual roll of D6. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn.

***Torrent of Blows***: Pick 1 of the target’s melee weapons. That weapon has **Crit (2 Hits)**.

***Protection of the Waves***: While this unit is within 3" of and visible to the target, both units have **WARD (5+)**.

***Frenzy of the Ethersea***: For each unmodified hit roll of 1 for a combat attack that targets that friendly unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the **FIGHT** ability has been resolved.
abilities.lore: The Tidecaster channels and manipulates the deep-sea magic of the ethersea in order to empower and defend their kin.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

units.lore: True masters of the ethersea, Isharann Tidecasters can manipulate this eldritch ocean to protect their allies and destroy their foes. They bring the Searing Sea to the Charrwind Coast, ensuring it is they who control the ebb and flow of battle.

units.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Namarti Reavers

abilities.name: Merciless Hunters
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a **SHOOT** ability for this unit
abilities.description:
Effect: After that **SHOOT** ability has been resolved, if all of this unit’s attacks targeted the same enemy unit and any models in that unit were slain, pick 1 of the effects below to apply for the rest of the turn. If all of this unit’s attacks targeted the same enemy unit and no models in that unit were slain, roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the effects below to apply for the rest of the turn:

• Subtract 1 from ward rolls for the target.
• Ignore positive modifiers to save rolls for the target.
abilities.lore: Namarti Reavers can fire arrows with such accuracy as to impair any defence, no matter how strong.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

units.lore: Fast‐moving scouts and archers, the eyeless Namarti Reavers are as uncannily accurate with their whisperbows upon the scorched earth of the Great Parch as they are beneath the waves.

units.name: Scourge of Ghyran Akhelian Thrallmaster

abilities.name: Raider Captain
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit and up to 3 friendly **Namarti Thralls** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Each target can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
abilities.lore: Thrallmasters are often among the first of the Idoneth’s forces to arrive on the battlefield, leading Namarti scouting parties to establish forward positions from which they can launch their raid.

abilities.name: Way of the Vortex
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit and friendly **NAMARTI** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The riptide’s undertow pulls allies from harm, a hidden bulwark against the enemy’s raging storm. Within its grasp, Namarti endure, shielded by the Akhelian’s unwavering stance.

details.notes:
This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as an *Akhelian Raidmaster*.
This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.

units.lore: Many ruthless Akhelian Thrallmasters ply the coasts of the Everspring Swathe, seeking out the rich accumulations of souls that can be found there. Masters of guerrilla warfare, these swordmasters and their Namarti warriors use the environment to protect them against enemy attacks as they advance, before charging in to deliver a killing strike.

units.name: Ikon of the Sea

abilities.name: Rapid Approach
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use a **RUN** ability and still use **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.
abilities.lore: Moving with liquid speed and uncanny agility, the Ikon is on its foes before they have a chance to react.

abilities.name: The Surging Sea
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit and up to 1 friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the targets, to a maximum of 3.
abilities.lore: The Ikon’s aura of calm yet fearsome power sweeps up nearby Idoneth, carrying them into battle like a racing current.

details.notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as an *Akhelian Raidmaster*.

units.lore: Channelling the unfathomable calm and foreboding immensity of the deepest waters, Ikons of the Sea surge into battle alongside their Idoneth kin, overwhelming the enemy with their unwavering focus and terrifying momentum. To witness such martial perfection is an inspiration to any Idoneth warrior.

units.name: Eidolon of Mathlann, Aspect of the Storm

weapons.name: Spear of Repressed Fury and Crulhook

abilities.name: Drench With Hate
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The mere presence of an Eidolon in its warrior aspect is enough to imbue nearby Idoneth with a fierce and bitter hate.

abilities.name: Crashing Upon The Foe
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use **CHARGE** abilities even if it used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by **RETREAT**  abilities.
abilities.lore: The Eidolon surges up into the sky before crashing down like a tidal wave, reforming to dive again and again until nothing is left of the enemy.

abilities.name: Pulled Into The Depths
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target has **STRIKE‑LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The viciously barbed crulhook can ensnare unfortunate foes.

units.lore: In its aspect of the storm an Eidolon of Mathlann is the vengeance of the Idoneth made manifest, a living tempest that surges upwards before crashing upon the foe with tidal‑wave force.

units.name: Volturnos, High King of the Deep

weapons.name: Uasall’s Fangs, Talons and Lashing Tails

abilities.name: First Among Akhelians
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by other friendly **AKHELIAN** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Volturnos is the greatest Akhelian King to have ever lived. His supreme skill and vast experience serve as an inspiration to all members of the Idoneth’s warrior caste.

abilities.name: Supreme Lord of Tides
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 other friendly **IDONETH DEEPKIN** units wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets’ melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: At the High King’s command, his warriors will attack with unrelenting fury.

abilities.name: Cealith, the High King's Shield
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has **WARD (3+)** against mortal damage inflicted by **SPELL** abilities, **PRAYER** abilities or abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS**.
abilities.lore: Cealith is said to have been crafted by Teclis himself. However it was created, the mystical aura it projects guards the bearer against malign magics.

units.lore: Volturnos is the last of the Cythai, a warrior whose cunning and prowess are legendary. Riding to battle atop Uasall, Prince of Deepmares, the High King carves a path through the foe, inspiring the Idoneth to ever greater deeds.

units.name: Akhelian Allopex

abilities.name: Bloodthirsty Predators
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Allopex’s Ferocious Bite** while it is within 6" of any damaged enemy units or while it is within 6" of any enemy units that had any models slain in the same turn.
abilities.lore: Allopexes are drawn towards the scent of freshly spilt blood.

abilities.name: Ensnared
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** or **CAVALRY** unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by this unit’s shooting attacks to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.
abilities.lore: The Akhelians are experts at ensnaring their prey with a well-placed harpoon or Retarius net.

units.lore: Allopexes are vicious predators of the deep, known for their voracious appetites. As Akhelian bond-beasts, they are more dangerous still, boasting scythed fins and deadly back-mounted harpoon launchers. Even the bravest fear these finned menaces.

units.name: Namarti Reavers

abilities.name: Strike on the Move
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use **SHOOT** abilities even if it used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
abilities.lore: Namarti Reavers are experts at running out from cover to unleash a hail of deadly arrows.

units.lore: Armed with silent‑firing whisperbows, Namarti Reavers are the fast‑moving scouts and archers of the Idoneth Deepkin Phalanxes. Despite their eerie and disturbing lack of eyes, they are uncannily accurate, using senses other than sight to pinpoint their targets.

battleTraits.name: Flying High
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** that is in a regiment from which no units have been deployed, then pick a number of units up to its Transport Capacity (see its warscroll) that are in its regiment.

Effect: Set up all of those units in reserve **in the clouds**. They have now been deployed.
battleTraits.lore: Often one skyvessel will hold back high above the battlefield, only to descend and deploy additional troops where and when they are most needed.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Kharadron Overlords armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: The Flagship
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** to be the target. The target can be in reserve.

Effect: The target has the **FLAGSHIP** keyword for the rest of the battle. If the target does not have a Great Endrinwork, give the target 1 Great Endrinwork.

**Designer’s Note:** *This Great Endrinwork is given to the unit during the deployment phase, not during army composition.*
battleTraits.lore: Every fleet commander designates one of their vessels to be their flagship.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Kharadron Overlords armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Descend from the Clouds
battleTraits.phase: Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL in the clouds** to use this ability.

Effect: Set up that **SKYVESSEL** anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up all other units that were set up **in the clouds** with that **SKYVESSEL** wholly within 6" of it and more than 9" from all enemy units.
battleTraits.lore: As a skyvessel swoops down to the battlefield, its Kharadron passengers scramble to disembark and storm the enemy lines.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Kharadron Overlords armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Transport Skyfarers
battleTraits.phase: Your Movement Phase, Reaction: You declared a non-CHARGE MOVE ability for a friendly SKYVESSEL
battleTraits.description:
Effect: Pick a number of units up to that **SKYVESSEL**’s Transport Capacity (see its warscroll) that are wholly within 6" of it and not in combat to be the targets. Units that have been transported this turn cannot be targets.

Remove the targets from the battlefield. After the **SKYVESSEL** ends its move, you must set up each target unit on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of that **SKYVESSEL** and not in combat. Those units have been transported. A unit cannot use **CHARGE** abilities if it was transported in the same turn.
battleTraits.lore: The Kharadron rule the skies of the realms with fleets of fearsome airships crewed by hardened duardin.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Kharadron Overlords armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Skyvessel Cover
battleTraits.phase: Passive
battleTraits.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly **KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY** units that have not charged in the same turn while they are wholly within 6" of a friendly **Arkanaut Ironclad** or **Arkanaut Frigate** that has not charged in the same turn.
battleTraits.lore: With a mighty skyvessel floating above providing covering fire, Kharadron Overlords are much harder to target.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Kharadron Overlords armies can use the following abilities:

ability.name: Extra Rappel Anchors
ability.description: Effect: Friendly **Grundstok Gunhaulers** can transport up to 2 friendly **KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY** units instead of 1 and with a combined model count of up to 6 instead of 5 (see Kharadron Overlords Battle Traits).
ability.lore: The Grundstok Gunhaulers in this force have been fitted with extra ports to which privateers can tether themselves in order to hitch a ride in battle.

abilities.name: Extra Rappel Anchors
abilities.description: Effect: Friendly **Grundstok Gunhaulers** can transport up to 2 friendly **KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY** units instead of 1 and with a combined model count of up to 6 instead of 5 (see Kharadron Overlords Battle Traits).
abilities.lore: The Grundstok Gunhaulers in this force have been fitted with extra ports to which privateers can tether themselves in order to hitch a ride in battle.

ability.name: Entrenched Crews
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Battle Round
ability.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **Arkanaut Company** units to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the battle round, if the target has not been set up this battle round and while it has not moved this turn, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of attacks that target that unit.
ability.lore: The Arkanauts in this fleet are no strangers to ground-based combat. Once in position, they will make clever use of the terrain to stymie the attacks of the foe.

abilities.name: Entrenched Crews
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Battle Round
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 friendly **Arkanaut Company** units to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the battle round, if the target has not been set up this battle round and while it has not moved this turn, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of attacks that target that unit.
abilities.lore: The Arkanauts in this fleet are no strangers to ground-based combat. Once in position, they will make clever use of the terrain to stymie the attacks of the foe.

ability.name: Special Procurement
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE KHARADRON OVERLORDS HERO** that does not have an artefact of power. The target can be in reserve.

Effect: Give that **HERO** 1 artefact of power from the ‘Inventions of the Sky-ports’ or the ‘Ingenious Innovations.

**Designer’s Note:** *This artefact of power is given to the unit during the deployment phase, not during army composition.*
ability.lore: The Endrineers Guild often charter expeditionary forces equipped with the most advanced inventions in the realms.

abilities.name: Special Procurement
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**UNIQUE KHARADRON OVERLORDS HERO** that does not have an artefact of power. The target can be in reserve.

Effect: Give that **HERO** 1 artefact of power from the ‘Inventions of the Sky-ports’ or the ‘Ingenious Innovations.

**Designer’s Note:** *This artefact of power is given to the unit during the deployment phase, not during army composition.*
abilities.lore: The Endrineers Guild often charter expeditionary forces equipped with the most advanced inventions in the realms.

ability.name: Gritty Fortune-hunters
ability.description: Effect: Friendly **Vongrim Harpoon Crew** and **Vongrim Salvagers** units have **WARD** **(6+)** while they are contesting an objective.
ability.lore: The Vongrim guilders in this expedition have almost depleted their current reserves of aether-gold. Their very existence depends on the success of this venture, and they’ll be damned if anyone tries to cheat them of their imminent windfall!

abilities.name: Gritty Fortune-hunters
abilities.description: Effect: Friendly **Vongrim Harpoon Crew** and **Vongrim Salvagers** units have **WARD** **(6+)** while they are contesting an objective.
abilities.lore: The Vongrim guilders in this expedition have almost depleted their current reserves of aether-gold. Their very existence depends on the success of this venture, and they’ll be damned if anyone tries to cheat them of their imminent windfall!

heroicTraits.name: Shrewd Opportunist
heroicTraits.description:
Declare: Pick this unit and up to 2 other friendly **KHARADRON OVERLORDS** non-**HERO INFANTRY** units to be the targets.

Effect: Each target can immediately use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.
heroicTraits.lore: This duardin’s mind is as sharp as a gem cutter. They are quick to see openings and do not hesitate to seize upon them. Such a quality is, of course, highly conducive to profit!

heroicTraits.name: Bold As Brass
heroicTraits.description: Effect: Add 5 to this unit’s control score.
heroicTraits.lore: Whether their roared oaths ring louder than the summons to Musterpress or the sheer audacity of their actions speaks volumes, this officer is an imposing presence on the battlefield.

heroicTraits.name: Combat Grafter
heroicTraits.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
heroicTraits.description: Effect: This unit can use 2 **FIGHT** abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the phase.
heroicTraits.lore: Knuckling down and cracking skulls is what this officer does best.

artefacts.name: Blazebeard and Sons Bamboozling Flakgun
artefacts.phase: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a CHARGE ability for a unit within 12" of this unit
artefacts.description: Effect: Pick 1 dice in that charge roll. Then, make a **bamboozling flak roll** of D6. If the roll equals or exceeds the value on the dice, remove that dice from the charge roll.
artefacts.lore: This large-barrelled, stumpy weapon fires a mishmash of workshop swarf coated in phosphor-laced aether-gold that produces a blinding, bewildering display when the trigger is pulled – highly effective for stopping an advancing enemy in their tracks.

artefacts.name: Celestium Burst Grenade
artefacts.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Shooting Phase
artefacts.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the turn.
artefacts.lore: Typically used by the Grundstok ‘black marines’, this specialised anti-ethereal weapon can nullify magical wards.

artefacts.name: Voidstone Orb
artefacts.phase: Once Per Battle, Reaction: Opponent declared a SPELL ability for a WIZARD within 30" of this unit
artefacts.lore: This small, unassuming black globe contains the power to disrupt enemy spells.

aqshyArtefacts.name: Persistent Drillbill
aqshyArtefacts.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+:
• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• If the target unit’s starting size was 1, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks until the start of your next turn.
aqshyArtefacts.lore: This avian cog-familiar is relentless; once it has a foe in its sights, it will harry and peck them to the exclusion of all else.

aqshyArtefacts.name: Experimental Aether-Powered Ejector Rig
aqshyArtefacts.phase: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
aqshyArtefacts.description: Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 3" of a friendly **SKYVESSEL** or **Zontari Endrin Dock** and more than 9" from all enemy units.
aqshyArtefacts.lore: This pioneer firmly believes that combat is for other duardin.

aqshyArtefacts.name: Heat-Seeking Auto-Endrin
aqshyArtefacts.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Until the start of your next turn, subtract your opponent’s **fury level** from the target’s control score.

***Designer’s Note**: Use your opponent’s fury level at the point the unit’s control score is determined.*
aqshyArtefacts.lore: Designed to home in on sources of rage-induced heat – of which there are no shortage in fiery Aqshy – this tiny auto-endrin harasses and distracts the incensed foe.

aqshyEnhancements.name: Artycle 25, Point 6
aqshyEnhancements.description: Effect: Friendly **KHARADRON OVERLORDS HEROES** have **WARD (5+)** while they are within this unit’s combat range.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: Crew members must ensure the adequate defence of their superiors during perilous expeditions.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText: Artycle References are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO KHARADRON OVERLORDS** **INFANTRY** units. A unit can only have 1 Artycle Reference.

aqshyEnhancements.name: Artycle 15, Point 4
aqshyEnhancements.description:
Effect: • Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks that target an enemy unit that has **FLY**.
• Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit’s combat attacks that target an enemy unit that does not have **FLY**.
aqshyEnhancements.lore: All duardin should be well versed in multiple combat techniques that can be employed against airborne and ground‐based enemies.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText: Artycle References are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO KHARADRON OVERLORDS** **INFANTRY** units. A unit can only have 1 Artycle Reference.

aqshyEnhancements.name: Artycle 20, Amendment 2
aqshyEnhancements.phase: Once Per Battle, Enemy Charge Phase
aqshyEnhancements.description:
Declare: If this unit has not charged this turn, pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: The target’s attacks cannot score critical hits for the rest of the turn (treat them as regular hits instead).
aqshyEnhancements.lore: Flare guns may be used in extremis to disorientate marauders and others with sinister motives.
aqshyEnhancements.restrictionText: Artycle References are unique enhancements that can be given to non-**HERO KHARADRON OVERLORDS** **INFANTRY** units. A unit can only have 1 Artycle Reference.

terrain.name: Zontari Endrin Dock

abilities.name: Endrinworks Outpost
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **AUTO-ENDRIN** or replacement **AUTO‑ENDRIN** that has been removed from the battlefield to be the target.

Effect: Make a manufacturing roll of D6. Add 1 to the roll if there is a friendly **Endrinmaster with Dirigible Suit** or **Endrinmaster with Endrinharness** within 3" of this terrain feature. On a 4+, set up a replacement **AUTO-ENDRIN** on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of this terrain feature and more than 3" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: The Endrin Dock continuously assembles new drones, a process that is expedited if a skilled endrineer is overseeing its operation.

abilities.name: Repair Routines
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** within 3" of this terrain feature to be the target.

Effect: Make a repair roll of D6. Add 1 to the roll if there is a friendly **Endrinmaster with Dirigible Suit** or **Endrinmaster with Endrinharness** within 3" of this terrain feature. On a 4+, **Heal (3)** the target.
abilities.lore: Auto-Endrins can be used to assist with combat repairs.

abilities.name: Release The Auto-Endrins
abilities.description: Effect: Set up a friendly **Nullifier Auto‑Endrin**, **Stuncloud Auto‑Endrin** and **Grudgeblast Auto‑Endrin** (see the Auto-Endrin warscroll) on the battlefield within friendly territory, wholly within 6" of this terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Automated defence drones spill from the dock like wasps from a nest.

terrain.lore: A cutting-edge innovation from the finest endrineering minds in the sky-empire, the Zontari Endrin Dock is designed to allow the Kharadron to defend their most precious assets. It deploys aether-powered auto-endrins that seek out enemy formations before detonating or deploying anti-magic measures.

units.name: Endrinmaster with Dirigible Suit

abilities.name: Combat Engineers
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit and up to 1 friendly **Endrinriggers** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, combat attacks made by the targets against enemy units that charged this turn have **Crit (2 Hits)**.
abilities.lore: Endrinmasters are trained in combat and possess a natural flair for command – bad news for would-be attackers.

abilities.name: Mobile Repairs
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** or **Zontari Endrin Dock** within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, **Heal (3)** the target.
abilities.lore: An Endrinmaster is well equipped to carry out emergency repairs in the midst of battle.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Guild Officer*.

units.lore: Many Endrinmasters take to the skies in master-crafted dirigible suits, their aetherturbines allowing them to zoom through the air towards skyvessels in need of repair even as an in-built weapon array blasts their enemies into pieces.

units.name: Aetheric Navigator

abilities.name: Aethersight
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can use **UNBIND** abilities as if it had **WIZARD (1)**.
abilities.lore: Aetheric Navigators can unpick enemy spells by harnessing the arcane jet streams.

abilities.name: Read the Winds
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** or **AUTO-ENDRIN** within this unit’s combat range and that is not in combat to be the target.

Effect: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, if the target is a **SKYVESSEL**, you can remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of the target and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Navigators can signal to nearby Kharadron airships, helping them to steer into prevailing currents.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Guild Officer*.

units.lore: Utilising cutting-edge aethermatic science in order to decipher the ever-changing wind patterns of the Mortal Realms, Aetheric Navigators are an invaluable presence upon any Kharadron skyvessel.

units.name: Arkanaut Ironclad

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Great Sky Ordnance** is 4.

abilities.name: Transport Capacity
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can transport up to 3 friendly **KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY** units with a combined model count of up to 22 (see Battle Traits).

abilities.name: Heavy Bomb Racks
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that does not have **FLY** and that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.

Effect: Roll 10 dice. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: This skyvessel carries a variety of bombs that can be dropped onto the battlefield.

abilities.name: Incoming!
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: The skyvessel fires a close-range fusillade at a foe bearing down upon it.

units.lore: Amongst the heaviest Kharadron ships of the line, the redoubtable Ironclads provide a floating fortress at the heart of any airfleet, bombarding their targets from afar with explosive shells and armour-piercing torpedoes.

units.name: Vongrim Harpoon Crew

abilities.name: Light Endrinpacks
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is in combat, it can move 2D6" but must end that move in combat.
abilities.lore: The aether-powered backpacks worn by the Vongrim allow them to travel light and swift.

units.lore: A Vongrim Harpoon Crew is a supreme monster-hunting machine, a gathering of grizzle-bearded veterans who have seen, fought and killed some of the meanest horrors to ply the sky-lanes. They pursue their prey with light endrinpacks, hurling skydrake harpoons that can punch through the armoured hide of a megalofin with ease.

units.name: Arkanaut Admiral

abilities.name: Bring Every Gun to Bear!
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** wholly within 24" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s ranged weapons.
abilities.lore: At the Admiral’s order, the skyvessel is steered into position to deliver a devastating salvo.

abilities.name: The Admiral's Flagship
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **FLAGSHIP** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the phase, each time the target uses a **SHOOT** ability, you can re-roll 1 of the hit rolls made for that ability.
abilities.lore: Every Admiral designates one of their vessels in the airfleet to be their flagship.

units.lore: Arkanaut Admirals are the cream of the sky-ports’ officer class, intrepid leaders and battle-hardened veterans of countless aerial engagements whose booming commands inspire their crews to mighty deeds in the search for profit.

units.name: Endrinmaster with Endrinharness

abilities.name: 'Aye Aye, Captain!'
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:

•  The target can use a **RETREAT** or **RUN** ability and still use **SHOOT** abilities later in the turn.
•  No mortal damage is inflicted on the target by **RETREAT** abilities.
abilities.lore: Under orders of the ship’s Captain, the Endrinmaster attempts to squeeze every bit of power out of a vessel’s endrin.

abilities.name: Mobile Repairs
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** or **Zontari Endrin Dock** within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, **Heal (3)** the target.
abilities.lore: An Endrinmaster is well equipped to carry out emergency repairs in the midst of battle.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Guild Officer*.

units.lore: Endrinmasters are peerless combat mechanics, well used to conducting emergency repairs in the white heat of battle. Many equip themselves with a strength-enhancing endrinharness that allows them to wield a fearsome aethermight hammer.

units.name: Arkanaut Frigate

abilities.name: Medium Bomb Racks
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that does not have **FLY** and that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.

Effect: Roll 6 dice. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: This skyvessel carries a variety of bombs that can be dropped onto the battlefield.

abilities.name: Incoming!
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: The skyvessel fires a close-range fusillade at a foe bearing down upon it.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Heavy Sky Ordnance** is 3.

abilities.name: Transport Capacity
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can transport up to 2 friendly **KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY** units with a combined model count of up to 12 (see Battle Traits).

abilities.name: Assault Boat
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit cannot use this ability if it is in combat or has used a **RUN** or **RETREAT** ability this turn. Pick a number of units up to its Transport Capacity that are wholly within 6" of it, that are not in combat and that have not charged this turn to be the targets. Then, make a charge roll of 2D6.

Effect: This unit can move a distance up to the value of the charge roll and must end the move within ½" of a visible enemy unit. If it does so:

• Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again wholly within this unit’s combat range. The targets can be set up in combat.
• This unit and the targets have charged, and the targets cannot use another **CORE** ability this phase.
• Pick up to 1 of the targets to have **STRIKE-FIRST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The Frigate is designed to deliver warriors directly into the fray.

units.lore: The unmistakable profile of an Arkanaut Frigate set against the sky is a sight greatly feared by the Kharadron’s many enemies, who know all too well the devastating firepower these airships possess and the fighting spirit of the privateers they carry into battle.

units.name: Null-Khemist

abilities.name: Nullsuit
abilities.description: Effect: Double the Damage characteristic of this unit’s weapons for attacks that target **PRIESTS**, **WIZARDS** or **MANIFESTATIONS**.
abilities.lore: A product of cutting-edge aethermatics, the nullsuit is designed to dampen magic and eliminate those who wield it.

abilities.name: Protection of the Void
abilities.description: Effect: While they are wholly within 12" of this unit, friendly **SKYFARER** units have **WARD (5+)** against mortal damage inflicted by **SPELL** abilities, **PRAYER** abilities and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS**.
abilities.lore: The powerful magic-quashing aura of null-gas causes spells and incantations to sputter and die.

details.notes: This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a *Guild Officer*.

units.lore: Clad from head to toe in the latest aether-powered anti-magic suit, a Null-Khemist stands prepared to enter the most hostile environments in the Mortal Realms. Spells and arcane bolts sputter and die in the face of their null-gas emitters, while anyone foolish enough to stray too close finds their extremities crushed by a pneumatic clamp.

units.name: Brokk Grungsson, Lord-Magnate of Barak-Nar

abilities.name: First Rule of Grungsson
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 2 other friendly **SKYFARER** units within this unit’s combat range to be the targets.

Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the targets’ melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: When Brokk Grungsson leads his warriors into battle, he reminds them of his first and most significant commentary on the Code.

abilities.name: Command the Fleet
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly **SKYVESSELS** wholly within 24" of this unit that are not in combat to be the targets.

Effect: Each target can use a **RUN** ability and still use **SHOOT** and/or **CHARGE** abilities later in the turn.
abilities.lore: Brokk’s preferred strategy is to instruct his fleet before leading his Skyriggers on bold manoeuvres to vanquish the enemy.

abilities.name: Moustache-mounted Aetherblasters
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: These custom aetherblasters deal short-range volleys of devastating fire.

units.lore: Lord-Magnate Brokk Grungsson is the richest Kharadron privateer alive. Clad in a custom-built endrinharness and carrying a small armoury of lethal firearms, he seeks out fresh sources of aether-gold with single-minded belligerence.

units.name: Endrinriggers

abilities.name: Emergency Field Repairs
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** or **Zontari Endrin Dock** within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: Make a field repairs roll of D6 for each model in this unit. For each 4-5, **Heal (1)** the target. For each 6, **Heal (2)** the target.
abilities.lore: Endrinriggers conduct intricate repair work even as battle rages around them.

units.lore: With aether-endrins strapped to their backs, Endrinriggers conduct repairs on their beloved airships miles above ground. In battle, their aether-powered tools become lethal weapons capable of punching through armour or messily sawing off limbs.

units.name: Scourge of Ghyran Codewright

abilities.name: Alright, Listen Up
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: If this unit is wholly within 12" of a friendly non-**HERO KHARADRON OVERLORDS** unit, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target. Then, choose to spend either 3 or 6 **vexed points**.

Effect: Pick 1 of the following effects to apply to the target for the rest of the turn:

• ***Do you see how fast they are going?!***: If you spent 3 **vexed points**, subtract D3 from the target’s Move characteristic. If you spent 6 **vexed points**, halve the target’s Move characteristic.
• ***Those weapons are against regulation!***: If you spent 3 **vexed points**, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks. If you spent 6 **vexed points**, subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons and subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s combat attacks.
abilities.lore: The Codewright’s fury at such blatant disregard for the precepts and carefully laid-out clauses of the Code is so infectious that nearby Kharadron unleash a barrage of hastily aimed ‘warning shots’, both to appease their surly charge and to force the enemy’s heads down.

abilities.name: I'm Watching You
abilities.description: Effect: Give this unit D3 **vexed points**.
abilities.lore: Squinting and scowling, the Codewright watches with hawkish scrutiny for any breaches of the Code.

details.notes:
This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Guild Officer*.
This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.

units.lore: The Kharadron’s profitable wars in the Everspring Swathe have led to a great demand for Codewrights, experts skilled in debating the finer points of the Kharadron Code. Their utter dedication to the rule of law is so intense that a bellowed quote from the Code can cause enemies to falter in confusion and sudden panic, rendering them easy targets.

units.name: Arkanaut Company

abilities.name: Grizzled Buccaneers
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+:
•  This unit can immediately use a **SHOOT** ability as if it were your shooting phase but all of its attacks must target the target enemy unit.
•  For the rest of the phase, this unit’s **Privateer Heavy Weapons** have **Shoot in Combat**.
abilities.lore: Arkanauts learn to fight with cutlass and pistol, combining the two to fearsome effect.

units.lore: The backbone of the Kharadron airfleets are the Arkanaut Companies. These grizzled privateers crew the sky-ports’ vessels and are armed with a variety of aether-powered firearms and deck tools with which to repel boarders or take the fight to the enemy.

units.name: Drekki Flynt

abilities.name: Captain of the Aelsling
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an **Arkanaut Frigate** in this unit’s regiment to be the target. This unit can use this ability while in reserve, and the target can also be in reserve.

Effect: The target has the **AELSLING** keyword. Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of the target’s **Boarding Weapons** for the rest of the battle.
abilities.lore: The *Aelsling* is manned by a motley crew of ne’erdo-wells with many a tale of daring combat to tell.

abilities.name: She Can Handle It!
abilities.description: Effect: You can re-roll run rolls and charge rolls for the **AELSLING** while it is wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: Captain Flynt understands the *Aelsling* and its capabilities better than he does his own kin.

abilities.name: Auxiliary Skyhook
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+:
•  Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
•  Subtract 1 from wound rolls made for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Drekki’s axe is custom-fitted with a small skyhook that can skewer beasties that stray too close.

units.lore: Drekki Flynt. It is a name to which tankards have been raised and curses levelled a thousand times. Captain of the *Aelsling*, fastest ship in Barak‑Mhornar, Flynt earns his reputation with flexible morals, an aether-powered axe and a multi‑barrelled pistol always close to hand.

units.name: Skywardens

abilities.name: Timed Charges
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+:

• Inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
• This unit can immediately use the ‘Retreat’ ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.
abilities.lore: Skywardens hurl explosive devices that shred the enemy and provide cover for their own retreat.

units.lore: Skywardens are elite formations of Arkanaut warriors granted the power of flight by portable aether-endrins. They swoop from on high to skewer enemies upon long-hafted skypikes or hover at short range to incinerate them with vulcaniser pistols.

units.name: Scourge of Ghyran Grundstok Gunhauler

abilities.name: Fighter Vessel
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit used a **SHOOT** ability this phase, this unit can move D6". It cannot end that move in combat.
abilities.lore: Gunhaulers are built for speed and manoeuvrability, zipping around larger vessels in the fleet to identify and eliminate priority targets.

abilities.name: Attack Squadron
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is wholly within 12" of any other friendly **Grundstok Gunhaulers**, it can use **SHOOT** abilities even if it used the ‘Run’ ability in the same turn.
abilities.lore: Groups of Gunhaulers range ahead to clear the way for larger skyvessels.

abilities.name: Transport Capacity
abilities.description: Effect: This unit cannot transport any friendly units.

details.notes:
This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.
This unit can be reinforced even though it has a minimum unit size of 1.

units.lore: State-of-the-art two-duardin attack craft, Grundstok Gunhaulers are the signature vessels of the Grundcorps. Both sturdy and swift, they have proved deadly above the tangled canopies of the Jade Kingdoms, taking on agile foes in aerial combat and laying waste to ground targets with a barrage of high-explosive bombs.

units.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Null-Khemist

abilities.name: Customised Nullsuit
abilities.description:
Effect: • This unit can use **UNBIND** and **BANISH** abilities as if it had **WIZARD (1)**.
• Add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making unbinding rolls and banishment rolls for this unit, to a maximum of 3.
abilities.lore: Additional pipes have been welded to the Null-Khemist’s suit that constantly vent excess nullstone gas around them in a magic-dispelling cloud.

abilities.name: Diligent Researcher
abilities.description: Effect: Each time your opponent spends any **rage dice** as part of the ‘Eruption of Fury’ ability, after that ability has been resolved, if this unit is not in combat, it can move up to **X**D6", where **X** is the number of **rage dice** spent. It cannot end that move in combat.
abilities.lore: A Null-Khemist does not stay still for long; after all, one cannot conduct proper field testing by remaining in one place.

details.notes:
This Hero can join an eligible regiment as a *Guild Officer*.

This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General's Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

units.lore: Kept comfortably cool in the Aqshian climes by their hermetically sealed nullsuits, Null-Khemists dart through the skies in their haste to test out their newest inventions. Woe betide those who stand between them and their research.

units.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Endrinriggers

abilities.name: We're Working Here!
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Effect: Until the start of your next turn, if this unit has not charged in the same turn, the following cumulative effects apply depending on your **fury level**.

**1+ *Irked***: This unit’s **Aethermatic Saws** have **Crit (Auto-wound)**.
**4+ *Exasperated***: This unit has **WARD (5+)**.
**7 *Incensed***: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.
abilities.lore: Burdened with the dangerous job of repairing skyvessels on the move, an Endrinrigger wants nothing more than to focus on the task in hand; engaging them in combat is a surefire way to garner their anger.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General's Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

units.lore: With aether-endrins strapped to their backs, Endrinriggers conduct repairs on their beloved airships miles above ground. In battle, their aether-powered tools become lethal weapons capable of punching through armour or messily sawing off limbs.

units.name: Grundstok Gunhauler

abilities.name: Aethershot Overwatch
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
abilities.lore: Woe betide those who charge a Grundstok gunline.

abilities.name: Long-line Slings
abilities.description: Effect: When you use the ‘Transport Skyfarers’ ability for this unit, you can pick units in combat to be targets.
abilities.lore: Specialised harnesses allow Kharadron to rapidly deploy from fast-moving vessels.

abilities.name: Transport Capacity
abilities.description: Effect: This unit can transport 1 friendly **KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY** unit with a model count of up to 5 (see Battle Traits).

abilities.name: Light Bomb Racks
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that does not have **FLY** and that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.

Effect: Roll 4 dice. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: This skyvessel carries a variety of bombs that can be dropped onto the battlefield.

units.lore: Small, manoeuvrable and deadly, the Grundstok Gunhauler is an escortclass ship tasked with ensuring the safety of the airfleets’ larger skyvessels. They perform this role well, swarming in defence before peeling off to launch blistering attack runs.

units.name: Grundstok Thunderers

abilities.name: Specialist Grundstok Ammunition
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase, Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick **Shieldbreaker** ammunition or **Thunderdrakk** ammunition.

Effect: If all of the attacks made for that **SHOOT** ability target the same enemy unit, after that **SHOOT** ability has been resolved, roll a dice and add the number of damage points allocated to the target by that **SHOOT** ability. If the roll is higher than the target’s Control characteristic, apply the following effect to the target based on the ammunition type picked:

***Shieldbreaker:*** Ward rolls cannot be made for the target until the start of your next turn.

***Thunderdrakk:*** That target has a maximum control score of 1 until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: The Gruncorps outfits its soldiers with the latest in experimental munitions.

units.lore: Grundstok Thunderers are heavily armoured marines employed by the airfleets to defend it from hostiles. Expert marksmen and battle-hardened veterans of many voyages, they obliterate their foes in a storm of aethershot and mortar rounds.

units.name: Aether-Khemist

abilities.name: Atmospheric Isolation
abilities.description: Effect: Subtract 1 from charge rolls for enemy units within 9" of this unit.
abilities.lore: An Atmospheric Anatomiser can create a localised vacuum steals the breath from an advancing enemy or depletes the arcane currents that impel foes of unnatural origin.

abilities.name: Aetheric Augmentation
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **Arkanaut Company** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target’s ranged weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: An Aether-Khemist can use their Anatomiser to augment the weapons of nearby skyfarers.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Guild Officer*.

units.lore: Masters of alchemy and atmospheric analysis, Aether-Khemists not only augment their comrades’ weapons with a boost of aether-gold, but they can also turn their esoteric devices against their foes to drain the air from their lungs.

units.name: Codewright

abilities.name: Advisory Role
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 visible friendly **SKYFARERS** units to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a dice for each target. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects to apply to that target for the rest of the turn:

***Seek New Prospects:*** Add 5 to the target’s control score.

***Don’t Argue with the Wind:*** Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for the target.

***There’s No Trading With Some People:*** The target can use a **RETREAT** ability and still use **SHOOT** abilities later in the turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on the target by **RETREAT** abilities.
abilities.lore: With the right tome at their fingertips, a shrewdly worded recommendation from a Codewright can have as much of an impact on a battle as a direct order from an Admiral.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Guild Officer*.

units.lore: With every artycle, every amendment and every footnote of the Kharadron Code learnt by heart, Codewrights are adept at not only citing obscure sections of the Code that can expedite the completion of their airfleet’s current objectives but also at adding ‘clarifications’ on the fly.

units.name: Vongrim Salvagers

abilities.name: Spotter's Flaregun
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an objective within 9" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the following effects for the rest of the turn:

• Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **SKYFARER** units that target a unit that is contesting the target objective.
• Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **Vongrim Salvagers** and **Vongrim Harpoon Crew** units for attacks that target a unit that is contesting the target objective.
abilities.lore: Firing this flaregun sends a message to all nearby Kharadron: this place is claimed and must be defended.

units.lore: Bonded by the shared trauma of lost ships and a sense of unity forged by hard times, Vongrim Salvagers go about their dangerous work with customary efficiency. With pistol, steel and cudgel, they cut down their foes and seize hold of profitable territory, refusing to give up their gains at any cost.

battleTraits.name: Ethereal
battleTraits.phase: Passive
battleTraits.description: Effect: Ignore negative modifiers to save rolls for friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units, excluding **Nagash.**
battleTraits.lore: Nighthaunt spirits can rarely be harmed by blows delivered by those caught in the grip of a spiritual terror.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Nighthaunt armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Ethereal Translocation
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
battleTraits.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit that is not in combat to use this ability.

Effect: Remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
battleTraits.lore: The Nighthaunt appear and disappear from sight to torment their prey.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Nighthaunt armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Mounting Dread
battleTraits.phase: Passive
battleTraits.description: Effect: Subtract the current battle round number from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with any friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units.
battleTraits.lore: The keening wails and harrowing shrieks of the Nighthaunt are a continuous assault on the courage of those who face them in battle, until their will to fight has all but crumbled.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Nighthaunt armies can use the following abilities:

battleTraits.name: Sepulchral Apparitions
battleTraits.phase: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
battleTraits.description:
Effect: If there is a friendly **Nexus of Grief** on the battlefield, you can set up up to 2 additional **Nexuses of Grief** on the battlefield. Each must be set up wholly outside enemy territory, more than 3" from all objectives and other terrain features, and more than 12" from all other friendly **Nexuses of Grief**.

**Designer’s Note:** *The original* **Nexus of Grief** *is set up in Step 1 of the deployment phase using the ‘Deploy Faction Terrain’ ability. This ability allows you to set up a second and third such terrain feature and is used in Step 3 of the deployment phase, after armies have been deployed.*
battleTraits.lore: Like sinister visions intruding upon reality, the haunted crypts of the Nighthaunt shimmer into existence wherever there are souls to be captured and tortured.
battleTraits.restrictionText: Nighthaunt armies can use the following abilities:

ability.name: Lethal Rancour
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick up to 2 friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** units to be the targets.

Effect: The targets' melee weapons have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)** for the rest of the turn.
ability.lore: The gheists of this horde are drawn from haughty nobles and obsequious courtiers who refused to admit fault even at the very end. They rail constantly at their kingdom's doom, and their undying bitterness renders their spectral touch even more deadly against those they perceive as interlopers.

ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT HERO** to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, enemy units cannot use **RETREAT** abilities while they are in combat with the target.
ability.lore: The screams and wails of this procession's bloodthirsty champions are so terrifying that their foes often become rooted in place, ripe for the slaughter.

abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Hero Phase
abilities.description:

ability.name: Vanish and Reappear
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit that is in combat to use this ability.

Effect: Roll a dice. The unit using this ability can move a distance up to its Move characteristic added to the roll. It can pass through other models and the combat ranges of enemy units, and it can end that move in combat.
ability.lore: These mercurial spirits are feared for their ability to dissolve into nothingness before suddenly reappearing elsewhere - often right behind their next targets' backs.

Effect: Roll a dice. The unit using this ability can move a distance up to its Move characteristic added to the roll. It can pass through other models and the combat ranges of enemy units, and it can end that move in combat.

ability.name: There Is No Escape
ability.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
ability.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **NIGHTHAUNT** unit to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn:

• The target can use **CHARGE** and **SHOOT** abilities even if it has used a **RETREAT** ability in the same turn.
• The target can use the 'Retreat' ability without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.
ability.lore: Death Stalkers are spectral killers that relentlessly hunt down a chosen enemy. They are constantly on the move in pursuit of their quarry and nigh impossible to pin down.
