terrain.name: Charnel Throne

abilities.name: Duty Calls
abilities.description: Effect: If this terrain feature has a Steward that was not placed on it this turn, set up the Steward on the battlefield wholly within 6" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer the Steward.
abilities.lore: When duty demands it, an abhorrant monarch or their regent will descend from the throne to take up the sword.

abilities.name: Ruler of All They Survey
abilities.description:
Declare: If this terrain feature has a Steward, pick a visible friendly non-**HERO FLESH-EATER COURTS** unit that is not in combat to be the target.

Effect: The target can move D3". If the target was set up this turn, it can move D6" instead. It cannot move into combat during that move.
abilities.lore: A steward may become convinced of their own grandeur and bid troops sally forth in their glorious name.

abilities.name: Steward of the Realm
abilities.description:
Effect: While this terrain feature has a Steward:

• The Steward cannot use **MOVE** abilities.
• Instead of measuring range or visibility to the Steward, measure to this terrain feature instead.
• All attacks that would target the Steward target this terrain feature instead.
• If this terrain feature is destroyed, before removing it from the battlefield, inflict D3 mortal damage on the Steward. Then, set up the Steward on the battlefield within 3" of this terrain feature and not in combat. That unit is no longer the Steward. If it is not possible to set up the Steward, it is slain.
abilities.lore: Those who sit upon a Charnel Throne rule over all they survey, but they must be wary of foes who would see them violently cast down.

abilities.name: Reigning Champion
abilities.description:
Declare: If this terrain feature does not have a Steward, pick a friendly **FLESH‐EATER COURTS INFANTRY HERO** within 3" of it and not in combat to be the target.

Effect: Place the target on this terrain feature. The target is now the Steward (see ‘Steward of the Realm’).
abilities.lore: A trusted member of the court may sit the throne in the absence of their liege-lord, though they must abdicate immediately on their return.

terrain.lore: Formed from the bones of those killed by an abhorrant, Charnel Thrones exude madness and necrotic energies. They are seats of power for Archregents and Ghoul Kings, blazing beacons to mordants and structures of abject horror for the enemies of the Flesh-eaters.

units.name: Crypt Haunter Courtier

weapons.name: Massive Bone Club and Rancid Talons

abilities.name: Knightly Exemplar
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly **Crypt Horrors** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Witnessing a Crypt Haunter Courtier’s frenzied, blood-spraying assault sends the warriors in their pack into a murderous frenzy.

abilities.name: Blessed Blood
abilities.description: Effect: **Heal (D3)** this unit.
abilities.lore: The blood of their liege grants these Flesh-eaters a supernatural regenerative capacity.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Royal Attendant*.

units.lore: Masters of a kingdom’s knightly echelons, Crypt Haunters are amongst the most physically powerful of an abhorrant’s courtiers. They lead their misbegotten kin in bone-crunching charges and revel in tearing foes limb from bloody limb.

units.name: Abhorrant Cardinal

abilities.name: Banishing Liturgy
abilities.description:
Effect: While you believe this **DELUSION**:

•  Add 2 to banishment rolls for friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS** units.
•  Friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS** units have **WARD (4+)** against damage points inflicted by **SPELL** abilities, **PRAYER** abilities and abilities used by **MANIFESTATIONS**.
abilities.lore: The solemn sacraments of a Cardinal and their faithful congregation can nullify the most hostile magics.

abilities.name: Insular Contemplations
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is more than 6" from all enemy units, add 1 to chanting rolls for this unit.
abilities.lore: A Cardinal’s ability to bend reality with their ranting is all the more potent when there are no questioning ‘heretics’ nearby.

units.lore: Abhorrant Cardinals seek to spread the glory of Ushoran across every land. Having drunk from the Carrion King’s chalice, they have gained a measure of unwitting control over the delusion, using bloody rites to stoke their flock’s rabid fury.

units.name: Scourge of Ghyran Abhorrant Ghoul King

abilities.name: The Kings Court
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons used by other friendly non-**MONSTER FLESH-EATER COURTS HEROES** while they are wholly within 12" of this unit. In addition, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for each other friendly non-**MONSTER FLESH-EATER COURTS HERO** wholly within 12" of this unit, to a maximum of +3.
abilities.lore: Ghoul Kings are often surrounded by their personal attendants, courtiers and royal family, who fight passionately to compete for their liege’s approval and whose loyalty fires the blood of their monarch in turn.

abilities.name: Long Live the King
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, friendly non-**UNIQUE FLESH-EATER COURTS** units wholly within 12" of this unit become **enraged** until the start of your next turn. Melee weapons used by friendly enraged units have **Crit (Auto-wound)** and score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 5+, even if this unit has been destroyed.
abilities.lore: The death of a member of the royal family sends shockwaves through the cannibal court, sending them into an impassioned rage.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.

units.lore: Utterly deranged, the Abhorrant Ghoul Kings of the Everspring Swathe believe themselves to be good and just rulers of forest kingdoms, rather than the flesh-eating nightmares they truly are. Their cadaverous minions are equally deluded. Such is their devotion to their vampiric master that should the Ghoul King fall they will enter a berserk rage, ripping and tearing those responsible to shreds.

units.name: Royal Decapitator

abilities.name: Off With Their Head!
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Immediately after that **FIGHT** ability has been resolved, pick an enemy **INFANTRY HERO** in combat with this unit to be the target. Roll 2D6. If the roll exceeds the target’s Health characteristic, it is automatically destroyed.
abilities.lore: A Royal Decapitator’s axe hungers to cleave through necks in one fell swing.

abilities.name: Executioner's Entourage
abilities.phase: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly **SERFS** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, the target’s melee weapons have **Crit (2 Hits)** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Though Royal Decapitators are often shunned by their fellow ghouls, when the blood starts flying, these sinister figures can attract quite the following.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Royal Attendant*.

units.lore: Viewed with unease even by fellow ghouls, the Royal Decapitators care only for the dealing of death. Dragging huge, tarnished axes behind them, they serve their lieges as gibbering executioners and delight in taking worthy heads.

units.name: Crypt Flayers (2 models)

abilities.name: To Our Liege!
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is not in combat, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 12" of a friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS HERO** and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: There are many ghoulish legends of Crypt Flayers winging down to join their lieges upon the battlefield.

details.notes: You can include 1 unit of this type for each **Crypt Infernal Courtier** in your army. This unit cannot be reinforced.

units.lore: Having gorged on the flesh of monsters and the blood of vampires, Crypt Flayers have mutated into winged abominations. Other ghouls exalt them for their boldness and the ‘purity’ of their voices – sonic screeches that can burst eardrums.

units.name: Scourge of Ghyran Abhorrant Gorewarden

abilities.name: Swooping Descent
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Enemy Turn
abilities.description:
Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield, then set it up again more than 9" from all enemy units and either:
• Wholly within 6" of the edge of the battlefield, or
• Within 3" of an objective you do not control.
abilities.lore: The Gorewarden takes to the skies, swooping across the battlefield to secure a glorious treasure for the court.

abilities.name: Glorious Charge
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly Knights unit and has charged this turn, this unit has **WARD (5+)** and its **Gory Talons and Fangs** have **Charge (+1 Damage)**.
abilities.lore: The Gorewarden launches into battle alongside their trusted knights.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2025-26* battlepack.

units.lore: Flying terrors on tattered wings, Abhorrant Gorewardens patrol the mordant kingdoms of Ghyran, seeking intruders or precious relics that their liege might desire. Should they spot such a target they will descend in a screeching dive, reclaiming the lands in the name of their Ghoul King and disembowelling any trespassers with raking talons.

units.name: Abhorrant Archregent

abilities.name: Musicians, Play!
abilities.description: Effect: While you believe this **DELUSION**, subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS** units while they are wholly within 12" of a friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS HERO**.
abilities.lore: On the Archregent’s signal, the court musicians strike up an exhilarating tune to which the joyful revellers begin to dance.

abilities.name: Countless Servants
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **SERFS** or **KNIGHTS** unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+:

• If the target is a **SERFS** unit, you can return up to 3 slain models to that unit.
• If the target is a **KNIGHTS** unit, you can return 1 slain model to that unit.
abilities.lore: With a chilling shriek, the Archregent summons some of their most trusted warriors.

units.lore: An Abhorrant Archregent rules over an entire empire of crazed cannibals. These vampires, amongst the oldest and most formidable of Ushoran’s brood, are unliving beacons of madness, commanding the devotion of innumerable ghouls.

units.name: Crypt Flayers

abilities.name: To Our Liege!
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is not in combat, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 12" of a friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS HERO** and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: There are many ghoulish legends of Crypt Flayers winging down to join their lieges upon the battlefield.

units.lore: Having gorged on the flesh of monsters and the blood of vampires, Crypt Flayers have mutated into winged abominations. Other ghouls exalt them for their boldness and the ‘purity’ of their voices – sonic screeches that can burst eardrums.

units.name: Cryptguard

abilities.name: Royal Bodyguard
abilities.description: Effect: While any friendly non-**MONSTER** **FLESH-EATER COURTS HEROES** are wholly within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those **HEROES** have **WARD (5+)**.
abilities.lore: In battle, it falls to the tenacious Cryptguard to form a half-living shield for their vampiric overlords.

abilities.name: Elite Guardians
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit is in combat with any enemy units that charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, this unit has **STRIKE‑FIRST** but ward rolls cannot be made for it.
abilities.lore: The Cryptguard will gladly give their lives to protect their liege from any who might do them harm.

units.lore: To join the Cryptguard, a ghoul must perform some great feat of endurance in the sight of their vampiric liege. Charged with protecting their unholy masters, they wield weapons from the monarch’s armoury – rusted blades inundated with maddening energies.

units.name: Royal Zombie Dragon

abilities.name: On Rotten Wings
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description: Effect: Remove this unit from the battlefield and set up it again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Hurling itself skyward, a Zombie Dragon descends on new and tantalising prey.

abilities.name: Necromantic Limits
abilities.description:
Effect: This unit’s **Draconic Claws** have a maximum Attacks characteristic of 10.

While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Draconic Claws** is 5.

abilities.name: Soaring Terror
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: If this unit charged this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit can move 2D6". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move in combat. Then, pick an enemy unit that this unit passed across during that move. Inflict D3 mortal damage on that enemy unit.
abilities.lore: The Zombie Dragon soars over the enemy warriors, scouring those below with its corrosive breath.

units.lore: A Zombie Dragon forms the crown jewel of any abhorrant’s royal menagerie, though these creatures inspire more revulsion than awe in sane folk. They circle above their prey before arrowing down into battle, a wave of charnel stink and horror stretching out before them.

units.name: Varghulf Courtier

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: Victory Feast
abilities.description:
Effect: If any models were slain by this unit this turn:

• **Heal (D6)** this unit.

•  If this unit is in combat, this unit can immediately move 10". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move in combat with the units it was already in combat with at the start of the move.

•  If this unit is not in combat, this unit can immediately move 10" but cannot end that move in combat.
abilities.lore: Varghulf rampages through the enemy’s ranks at will, its wounds sealing with unholy rapidity as it guzzles the flesh of the savaged foe.

units.lore: Varghulfs are the most degenerate of all Ushoran’s vampiric brood, their bestial nature reflected in their unholy form. Nevertheless, to the ghouls, the Varghulfs are saintly champions indeed, and they follow them to battle with a rapturous joy.

units.name: High Falconer Felgryn

abilities.name: Be Mine Eyes
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit’s **Grype** is a token. If this unit’s **Grype** is not next to an enemy unit, pick an enemy unit within 18" of this unit and not in combat to be the target.

Effect: Place this unit’s **Grype** next to the target. If the target is destroyed while this unit’s **Grype** is next to it, remove this unit’s **Grype** from the battlefield.
abilities.lore: Felgryn and his favoured ‘falcon’, Grype, are adept at rooting out hidden prey.

abilities.name: Sir Felgryn is Abroad!
abilities.description: Effect: While you believe this **DELUSION**, subtract 10 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with any friendly **SERFS** units or any friendly non-**HERO FLESH‑EATER COURTS MONSTER** or **BEAST** units.
abilities.lore: Felgryn’s roguish example and affinity with animals make him beloved of commonfolk and creature alike, each resisting all the more fiercely when he takes to the field.

abilities.name: Winged Reconnoitrer
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit’s **Grype** is next to an enemy unit, ward rolls cannot be made for damage points inflicted on that enemy unit by combat attacks made by this unit and friendly **SERFS** units.
abilities.lore: The screeches of Felgryn’s twisted ‘falcon’ act as a beacon to other cannibal hunters.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Royal Attendant*.

units.lore: Beloved by the serf masses and reviled by his fellow abhorrants, Felgryn is an especially beastly example of an already monstrous lineage. It is fitting that this blood-crazed vampire has a particular affinity with wild creatures; these delusion-wracked beasts heed his garbled commands, spying hidden foes and setting on them with flashing talons.

units.name: Marrowscroll Herald

abilities.name: The King's Entreaty
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Charge Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 6" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, your opponent must decide whether the target will accept or reject the entreaty offered by this unit.

***Accept:*** The target has the **INFECTED** keyword for the rest of the battle.
***Reject:*** The target has **STRIKE-LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The message within the infected bone carried by a Marrowscroll Herald is an entreaty to madness and carnage; to reject it is to rouse the ire of the ghoulish throngs.

abilities.name: Infected
abilities.phase: Reaction: Opponent declared a command, SPELL ability or PRAYER ability for an INFECTED unit
abilities.description:
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 5+:

•  If they declared a command, that command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.
•  If they declared a **SPELL** or **PRAYER** ability, that spell or prayer fails.

This reaction can be used more than once per phase but only once per command, **SPELL** ability or **PRAYER** ability.
abilities.lore: As they start to lose their grip on reality, the infected find tasks that were previously second nature to them increasingly difficult.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Royal Attendant*.

units.lore: Marrowscroll Heralds are senior delegates of the court, sent to deliver entreaties to the other nations of the realms. In doing so, they spread the curse of Ushoran far and wide, leaving desolation and madness in their wake.

units.name: Royal Terrorgheist

abilities.name: Necromantic Limits
abilities.description:
Effect: This unit’s **Skeletal Talons** have a maximum Attacks characteristic of 10.

While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Skeletal Talons** is 4.

abilities.name: Shriek of Terror
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy **INFANTRY** unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice for each model in the target unit. For each 6, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target. If 3 or more damage points are allocated to the target by this ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: The soul-rending shriek of a Terrorgheist is enough to stop a warrior’s heart.

abilities.name: Wicked Predator
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: For each champion, standard bearer and musician in the target unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Skeletal Talons**, to a maximum of 10, for the rest of the phase. Those additional attacks must target that enemy unit.
abilities.lore: In life, Terrorgheists were cruel and spiteful monsters, dark instincts driving them to terrify prey into submission. Little has changed in death.

units.lore: Terrorgheists are the rotten, reanimated carcasses of ancient chiropteran titans, as bitter and sinister in life as they are in death. Consumed by hunger, their screams blast free of their vile bodies, shredding the very souls of any who hear them.

units.name: Abhorrant Gorewarden

abilities.name: Trespassers!
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit if it is **patrolling the borders**, then pick an enemy unit to be the target.

Effect: Set up this unit more than 6" from the target and more than 9" from all other enemy units. Then, set up the units that were **patrolling the borders** with this unit wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: When intruders are sighted, a Gorewarden and their flock make haste towards them, shrieking bloody murder

abilities.name: Lord of the Marches
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick this unit and up to 2 friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS** units in this unit’s regiment that have not been deployed to be the targets.

Effect: Set up the target units in reserve **patrolling the borders**. They have now been deployed.
abilities.lore: A Gorewarden is responsible for patrolling the borders of their liege’s territory, leading flights of warriors to ambush their enemies.

abilities.name: Defenders of the Kingdom
abilities.description:
Effect: While you believe this **DELUSION** and this unit is on the battlefield, add 1 to charge rolls for friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS** units while they are wholly within 12" of a friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS HERO**. Add 2 to charge rolls instead if they were also set up in the same turn.

When using the ‘A Kingdom Deluded’ ability, you can pick this **DELUSION** even if this unit is **patrolling the borders**.
abilities.lore: The Gorewarden and their sworn swords quickly repel any intrusion over the kingdom’s borders.

units.lore: Gorewardens bear the keys to the kingdom and oversee the protection of their liege’s borderlands. Clad in what they perceive to be great finery, they lead flights of bloodthirsty predators to savage unwary intruders.

units.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Royal Decapitator

abilities.name: Heads on Pikes
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: If any damage points were allocated to an enemy **HERO** by this unit’s combat attacks this turn and that enemy **HERO** has been destroyed, pick an objective or terrain feature within 6" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Spend 1 **rage dice**. If your opponent’s **fury level** is lower than yours, they must increase their **fury level** by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, for the rest of the turn, subtract 5 from the control scores of enemy units while they are contesting the target objective or terrain feature.
abilities.lore: The severed heads of leaders sentenced to death by the Decapitator are put on display as effective deterrents.

abilities.name: Executioner and Enforcer
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick another friendly **FLESH-EATER COURTS INFANTRY** unit within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

Effect: 1 model in the target unit is automatically slain. Then, until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each visible friendly **FLESH-EATER COURTS** unit in each phase while it is wholly within 12" of this unit.
abilities.lore: The Royal Decapitator acts as a grim reminder to their fellow ghouls that cowardice is a high crime in Ushoran’s court.

details.notes:
This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Royal Attendant*.

This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

units.lore: The axes wielded by the headsmen of the courts hunger for slaughter, and the Royal Decapitators are quick to satiate them, cleaving worthy heads from their bodies as they traverse the Great Parch.

units.name: Abhorrant Ghoul King

abilities.name: Code of Honour
abilities.description: Effect: While you believe this **DELUSION**, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly non-**UNIQUE FLESH‑EATER COURTS HEROES** for attacks that target an enemy **HERO**.
abilities.lore: Delusions of chivalry and honourable combat swirling, the Ghoul King issues direct challenges to enemy champions.

abilities.name: Vassals, to Arms!
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
abilities.description: Effect: Pick a friendly **SERFS** unit that has not used a **FIGHT** ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a **FIGHT** ability immediately after the **FIGHT** ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to wound rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Standing tall in the midst of the melee, this regal lord swiftly delivers an impassioned speech that inspires nearby serfs.

units.lore: From ruling their subjects to serving as part of a sprawling, monstrous royal family, abhorrant vampires possess great power amongst the ghoulish courts. Many display a warped honour, hunting enemy champions to tear apart in single combat.

units.name: Abhorrant Ghoul King on Royal Terrorgheist

abilities.name: A Majestic Menagerie
abilities.description: Effect: While you believe this **DELUSION**, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of **Companion** melee weapons used by friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS** units while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS HEROES**.
abilities.lore: Magnificent are the courtly warbeasts, resplendent in glittering armour and utterly loyal to their noble masters.

abilities.name: Wicked Predator
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: For each champion, standard bearer and musician in the target unit, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s **Terrorgheist’s Skeletal Talons**, to a maximum of 10, for the rest of the phase. Those additional attacks must target that enemy unit.
abilities.lore: In life, Terrorgheists were cruel and spiteful monsters, dark instincts driving them to terrify prey into submission. Little has changed in death.

abilities.name: Ferocious Hunger
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description: Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made with this unit’s **Companion** melee weapons for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Assailed by visions of the glorious feast to come, the abhorrant’s steed is filled with a hunger-driven impetus.

abilities.name: Necromantic Limits
abilities.description:
Effect: This unit’s **Terrorgheist’s Skeletal Talons** have a maximum Attacks characteristic of 10.

While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Terrorgheist’s Skeletal Talons** is 4.

units.lore: To an abhorrant vampire, their Terrorgheist steed appears as a glorious, white‑feathered lord of the sky. The reality is that these bat-like goliaths are ferocious and foul – traits that they share with their cannibal masters as they descend upon their prey.

units.name: Scourge of Aqshy: Varghulf Courtier

abilities.name: Beast
abilities.description: Effect: This unit has a maximum control score of 1.

abilities.name: The Howling Saint
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly **FLESH-EATER COURTS PRIEST** wholly within 18" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: The next time the target uses a **PRAYER** ability this phase:

• When picking targets for that prayer, you can measure range and visibility from this unit instead of from the chanter.
• Add 1 to the chanting roll for that prayer.
abilities.lore: Varghulfs are the holiest servants of Ushoran, their blessed presence serving to deepen the faith and amplify the conviction of nearby clerics.

details.notes: This unit is legal for Matched Play for battles fought using the *General’s Handbook 2026-27* battlepack.

units.lore: Viewed as saintly champions by the ghouls in their shared delusion, in reality, Varghulfs are utterly feral vampiric monstrosities. Their bestial nature reflected in their unholy form, Varghulfs stalk the plains of Aqshy in search of fresh meat.

units.name: Abhorrant Ghoul King on Royal Zombie Dragon

abilities.name: Draconic Terror
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll exceeds the target’s Control characteristic, the target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: To behold such a majestic beast as a dragon in the grip of undeath evokes awe and abject terror in equal measure.

abilities.name: Necromantic Limits
abilities.description:
Effect: This unit’s **Draconic Claws** have a maximum Attacks characteristic of 10.

While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Draconic Claws** is 5.

abilities.name: For The Kingdom!
abilities.description:
Effect: While you believe this **DELUSION**, add 1 to charge rolls for friendly Knights units and friendly **FLESH-EATER COURTS MONSTERS** while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly **FLESH-EATER COURTS HEROES**.

Add 2 to charge rolls for friendly **KNIGHTS** units and friendly **FLESH-EATER COURTS MONSTERS** instead while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly **Abhorrant Ghoul Kings on Royal Zombie Dragons**.
abilities.lore: Brave nobles lead the thunderous charge of the court’s knights and royal warbeasts, but none are as inspirational as this abhorrant.

abilities.name: Monstrous Hunger
abilities.description: Effect: While they are wholly within 12" of this unit, friendly non-**HERO FLESH‑EATER COURTS MONSTERS** can use **CHARGE** abilities even if they used a **RUN** ability in the same turn.
abilities.lore: The Ghoul King imposes their will upon the creatures of the court’s menagerie, awakening a glimmer of predatory hunger in long-dead senses.

units.lore: To fly a noble drake into battle is the desire of many an abhorrant liege. Though these corpse-beasts are, in truth, rotting and pestilent, there is a certain morbid majesty to them that serves to stoke the hunger of their fellow undead beasts.

units.name: Royal Beastflayers

abilities.name: Hunter's Instincts
abilities.description:
Effect: Enemy **MONSTERS** cannot use **RAMPAGE** abilities while they are in combat with this unit.
In addition, subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of melee weapons used by enemy **MONSTERS** and **BEAST** units while they are in combat with this unit.
abilities.lore: Royal Beastflayers believe themselves to be the finest monster-slayers in all the land. Certainly, they possess a knack for hindering and ensnaring their prey before moving in to make the kill.

details.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.

units.lore: Led by vampiric Flaymasters, the Royal Beastflayers are obsessed with hunting the monsters that lurk throughout the realms. It matters not if their prey are genuine abominations or noble beasts – all make for a fine banquet indeed.

units.name: Crypt Horrors

abilities.name: Holy Blades of Bone
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll 2 dice for each model in this unit. Add 2 to each roll if the target is **CAVALRY**. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: Crypt Horrors wield huge, monstrous femurs – as well as other grisly relics – as if they were blessed weapons.

units.lore: Creatures of truly imposing size and might, Crypt Horrors are formidable linebreakers. In their own minds, they are valorous knights, and their hunger to perform worthy deeds under their lord’s gaze drives them into a rabid frenzy.

units.name: Crypt Infernal Courtier

abilities.name: On Winged Steeds
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly **Crypt Flayers** unit that used the ‘To Our Liege!’ ability this turn and is wholly within 9" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: The target can immediately move D3" but cannot end that move in combat.

abilities.name: Mind-shattering Cacophony
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this turn by attacks made with this unit’s **Piercing Death Screech** to be the target.

Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of ranged weapons used by friendly **Crypt Flayers** units for attacks that target that enemy unit.
abilities.lore: When a Crypt Infernal Courtier directs their retinue to focus their death screams on an enemy, the resulting discordant soundwaves can fell the mightiest of foes.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Royal Attendant*.

units.lore: Crypt Infernals are terrors of the skies and often lead the bodyguard of an abhorrant monarch. Blessed with leathery wings, they soar upon thermals and keep watch for the enemy - upon sighting them, they let loose a sonic bombardment that blasts the mind.

units.name: Morbheg Knights

abilities.name: Predator Knights
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Enemy Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. Then, this unit can use a **RETREAT** ability as if it were your movement phase. No mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by that **RETREAT** ability.
abilities.lore: Though they lack the power of true flight, nightshriekers can leap clean over obstacles and the heads of the foe, allowing the Morbheg Knights to strike and disengage at will.

units.lore: The grisly cavaliers known as Morbheg Knights are amongst the proudest of a court’s warriors. They bound to battle atop the half-living nightshriekers, hideous spawn of the ur-bat Morbheg.

units.name: Nagash, Supreme Lord of the Undead

abilities.name: Supreme Lord of the Undead
abilities.phase: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a friendly non-**HERO** non-**UNIQUE DEATH** unit that has been destroyed to be the target.

Effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
abilities.lore: Nagash is the undisputed master of all undead creatures.

abilities.name: Utter Contempt
abilities.description: Effect: This unit ignores the effects of **DELUSION** abilities.
abilities.lore: Nagash is disgusted by the rabid mania of the Flesh-eaters, but their usefulness to his goals is beyond doubt.

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, subtract 3 from its power level.

abilities.name: Invocation of Nagash
abilities.description:
Declare: This unit can cast this spell more than once per phase. Pick a visible unit wholly within 18" of this unit that has not been picked to be the target of this spell this turn to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.

Effect: If the target is an enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage on it. If the target is a friendly **DEATH** unit, pick 1 of the following effects:

• Return a number of slain models to the target unit with a combined Health characteristic of up to 3.
• The target has **WARD (5+)** until the start of your next turn.
abilities.lore: In a storm of morbid sorcery, Nagash blasts his foes’ souls or re-knits his minions’ bodies.

abilities.name: Hand of Dust
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy **HERO** or **MONSTER** in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Hide a dice in one of your hands or under one of two appropriate containers. Your opponent must pick one of your hands or containers. If they pick the one hiding the dice, this ability has no effect. If they pick the empty one, the target is automatically destroyed.
abilities.lore: Nagash’s touch can turn a foe to a pile of dusty bones in moments.

abilities.name: The Staff of Power
abilities.description: Effect: Add 2 to casting rolls for this unit while it has not miscast any spells this turn. If this unit miscasts a spell, ignore the restriction that would stop this unit from casting any more spells this turn.
abilities.lore: Alakanash is capped with gems of purest grave-sand.

units.lore: All living beings dread the name of Nagash, the God of Undeath. Cruel and tyrannical, the overlord of Shyish intends to conquer the Mortal Realms and transform them into a lifeless Necrotopia, in which not a speck of dust moves unless it is by his will.

units.name: Grand Justice Gormayne

abilities.name: Arrest Those Miscreants!
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target has **STRIKE-LAST** while it is in combat with any friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS HEROES** and any friendly **SERFS** or **KNIGHTS** units.
abilities.lore: Should an enemy break Ushoran’s laws, Gormayne is quick to condemn them.

abilities.name: Accusations of Regicide
abilities.description: Effect: While you believe this **DELUSION**, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **SERFS** and **KNIGHTS** units while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS HEROES** that had any damage points allocated to them in the same turn.
abilities.lore: Of the many crimes Gormayne is empowered to punish, few stir his jury to a frenzy more than an attempt to harm the nobility.

details.notes: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Royal Attendant*.

units.lore: Grand Justice Gormayne ensures that the Carrion Kings insane laws are followed and those who transgress are punished. A cunning orator, he spurs his ghoulish jury' into a frothing rage, condemning foes to be bloodily torn apart.

units.name: Crypt Ghouls

abilities.name: Royal Approval
abilities.description: Effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons while it is wholly within 12" of any friendly **NOBLES** or **ABHORRANTS**.
abilities.lore: These mordants will always do their utmost to attract the attention of their sovereign.

units.lore: Crypt Ghouls form the lowly and indentured serfs of an abhorrant's domain. Though they are individually stunted and wild, their madness grants them a fiendish form of courage, and in numbers, they can overwhelm even the mightiest warriors.

units.name: Ushoran, Mortarch of Delusion

abilities.name: Battle Damaged
abilities.description: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its **Monstrous Talons** is 4.

abilities.name: Glimpse of Delusion
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy model within 18" of this unit to be the target, pick an enemy unit that is visible to the target and within the target’s combat range to be the victim, then make a casting roll of 2D6. You can only pick the target’s unit to be the victim if that unit has 2 or more models.

Effect: Pick 1 of the target’s melee weapons. Immediately resolve combat attacks for the target made with that weapon against the victim.
abilities.lore: Ushoran pulls an enemy into his delusion, causing them to see friends as vicious monsters.

abilities.name: The One True King
abilities.description:
Effect: While you believe this **DELUSION**:

•  Add 1 to run rolls and charge rolls for friendly **FLESH‑EATER COURTS** units.
•  Subtract 1 from run rolls and charge rolls for enemy units.
•  The melee weapons used by friendly **SERFS** units have **Anti-charge (+1 Rend)** while they are wholly within friendly territory and did not charge in the same turn.
abilities.lore: News of Ushoran’s mighty deeds spreads like wildfire through the Flesh‑eater ranks, inspiring his subjects to carry out their duties with greater vigour.

abilities.name: Epicentre of Delusion
abilities.description: Effect: Each time you make a delusion roll, you can add 1 to or subtract 1 from the roll.
abilities.lore: In fleeting moments of near lucidity, Ushoran has a small degree of control over the delusion believed by the cannibal army.

abilities.name: Shroudcage Fragment
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick up to 3 enemy units in combat with this unit to be the targets.

Effect: Roll a dice for each target. If the roll exceeds the target’s Control characteristic, the target has **STRIKE‑LAST** for the rest of the turn.
abilities.lore: Madness pulses from the gem in Ushoran’s crown, overwhelming those who draw too close.

units.lore: An ancient and monstrous lord amongst vampires, Ushoran is one of the most dreaded of Nagash’s Mortarch servants. He is a font of cursed madness, escalating the mania of his ghoul servants even as he annihilates foes with talon and gore-splattered sceptre.

units.name: Crypt Horrors (2 models)

abilities.name: Holy Blades of Bone
abilities.phase: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilities.description:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.

Effect: Roll 2 dice for each model in this unit. Add 2 to each roll if the target is **CAVALRY**. For each 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.
abilities.lore: Crypt Horrors wield huge, monstrous femurs – as well as other grisly relics – as if they were blessed weapons.

details.notes: You can include 1 unit of this type for each **Crypt Haunter Courtier** in your army. This unit cannot be reinforced.

units.lore: Creatures of truly imposing size and might, Crypt Horrors are formidable linebreakers. In their own minds, they are valorous knights, and their hunger to perform worthy deeds under their lord’s gaze drives them into a rabid frenzy.
